You have

title: WEB DESIGNER-DEVELOPER – LANDING PAGES + WEBSITE MAINTENANCE – DUBAI AGENCY
description:
ABOUT US


 is a Dubai agency that builds lead-generation systems (Google Ads, Meta Ads, landing pages) for high-ticket service businesses: law firms, consultants, real estate, clinics, restaurants. Small team, direct line to the founder, no middle management. We work with Claude Code daily and expect you to as well.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Build landing pages and funnels in HTML/CSS/Tailwind from written briefs, with Claude Code as your coding partner. The conversion structure is given. The visual quality is yours: pages must look premium, not templated.



Maintain our existing client websites: WordPress/Elementor sites, Webflow sites, custom PHP sites (Hostinger). Content changes, fixes, page builds from briefs.



Technical SEO and AI-search (AEO) across client sites: Rank Math, sitemaps, noindex rules, schema, robots/llms.txt, Core Web Vitals, alt text.



QA your own work on desktop and mobile before you report it done. Every time.



YOU

3+ years building websites, with real landing pages you designed AND built yourself.



Strong visual sense: typography, spacing, hierarchy. You can make a page look expensive without a designer handing you a Figma file.



Hands-on HTML/CSS (Tailwind a plus), WordPress/Elementor, Webflow. Basic PHP reading ability.



You already use an AI coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily work.



Technical SEO fundamentals: you know what a canonical, a noindex and an LCP are and have fixed them.



English: clear written reports. Our briefs are written; your updates are written.



HOW WE WORK

Written briefs with numbered steps. You execute them exactly, verify every step, then report with URLs and screenshots. Instructions in bold saying "do not touch" are absolute.



Questions come with what you tried and your proposed answer.



Hours: 09:00-18:00 Dubai time (13:00–22:00 Manila), Monday to Friday. Exclusive: no other jobs or freelance work.



Pay: USD 1,000–1,200/month depending on your test result, paid monthly via Payoneer. Permanent position, cancellable monthly by either side in the first 3 months.



Start: within 7 days of offer, or on an agreed date.



HIRING PROCESS

Written application (below). 2. Paid 48-hour test task (USD 50). 3. 30-minute video interview with the founder. 4. Offer. No unpaid work at any stage.



HOW TO APPLY – READ THIS TWICE

Applications that do not follow this format are not read.



First line of your message, exactly: WDD – Your Name – X, where X is the number of Webflow sites mentioned in this post.



Then answer these five questions, numbered 1–4, in this order. Maximum 400 words total, excluding links.



1. Three landing pages or websites you designed AND built yourself. For each: live URL, what you built (design, code, both), which tool (HTML/Tailwind, Elementor, Webflow, other). 



2. A 30-60-second unedited screen recording (Loom or similar): open one of those pages in its code or editor and walk through one section you built. Face cam optional, voice required.



3. Scenario: a brief says "Delete the Debt Recovery card from the services grid" and, in bold, "Do not touch the header." You delete the card. Then you notice a broken link in the header. In 3-5 sentences: what exactly do you do, in what order?



4. Confirm: (a) you can work 09:00–18:00 Dubai time exclusively, (b) your earliest start date, (c) your expected monthly salary in USD.



We reply to every application that follows the format.

description:
# Senior Home Care Recruiting & Scheduling Team Lead

**Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | US Eastern Time**



Consistent Solution Nursing is a growing RN-led private-pay home care and private duty nursing agency based in Massachusetts.



We are seeking a highly experienced Recruiting & Scheduling Team Lead to oversee our existing remote team.



This is a leadership position for someone with direct experience supporting US home care agencies. We are not looking for a general virtual assistant or someone who needs to be trained in home care recruitment.



### Key Responsibilities

- Supervise and manage our existing recruiting and scheduling team

- Monitor daily recruiter productivity, applicant pipelines and hiring progress

- Oversee scheduling performance and ensure staffing needs are addressed promptly

- Manage and maintain our Applicant Tracking System (ATS)

- Establish recruiting targets and hold team members accountable

- Identify weaknesses in recruiting and scheduling workflows

- Ensure a consistent pipeline of qualified caregivers, CNAs, HHAs, RNs and LPNs

- Conduct team meetings, provide coaching and monitor performance

- Submit daily and weekly operational reports directly to the Director of Operations



### Required Qualifications

- Minimum 3 years of direct experience supporting US home care or private-duty nursing agencies

- **Proven hands-on experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) is mandatory**

- Experience managing caregiver recruiting pipelines from application through onboarding

- Previous experience supervising recruiters, schedulers or remote administrative teams

- Strong understanding of US caregiver staffing, scheduling and recruitment processes

- Experience with healthcare staffing or home care management software

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to work independently, solve problems and hold a team accountable

- Must be available during US Eastern Time business hours



**Candidates without direct US home care experience or hands-on ATS experience will not be considered.**



### How to Apply



Please submit your resume and answer the following:



1. Which US home care agencies have you supported, and for how long?

2. Which Applicant Tracking Systems have you used? Describe your experience managing recruitment pipelines.

3. Have you supervised recruiters or schedulers? How many?

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recruiting and scheduling operations and help build a strong, accountable team.

description:

title: Social Media Content Editor & Creator Coordinator | Amazon Brands
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across the US, CA, UK, EU, AU and JP - two brands (travel accessories and beauty devices), 52+ active SKUs, on Amazon and our own websites. This role owns social media for both brands and sits in our Creative team.



The Role

You won't start from an empty folder. We already hold a library of influencer and UGC content, and more arrives continuously. Your job is to turn that supply into a consistent, well-edited output across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and
 - and to keep two very different brand voices distinct. Short-form vertical video is the default format.



This is a hands-on content role - not posting-only, and not purely strategic. You edit, you publish, and you run our creator pipeline.



What You'll Own

- Editing short-form vertical video to a publishable standard- on your own, quickly, without waiting for anyone.

- Turning raw creator footage, stock and product assets into finished posts, native to each platform - the same idea shaped differently as a Reel, a TikTok and a Short.

- Sourcing, vetting, briefing and negotiating creators for both brands, with usage rights agreed in writing before the shoot.

- Running the UGC pipeline: brief what you need, chase delivery, keep a clear record of every asset - who made it, what rights we hold, how long they run.

- A short weekly report: what published, what worked, audience growth.



What You'll Grow Into

Setting the social strategy and content pillars for both brands; running paid social on Meta and TikTok; email capture and follower-to-customer flows; and TikTok Shop's affiliate programme. 



Who We're Looking For

- A fast, self-sufficient editor with a portfolio you edited or directed.

- 3+ years running social and creator content for a consumer brand.

- You know why a video holds attention in the first two seconds.

- Comfortable with CapCut, Meta's Edits or Premiere, and Canva.

- You can tell a valuable, relevant audience from a large-but-low-quality follower count.

- Solid written English. 

- E-commerce experience, ideally website + marketplace, is a plus.



Tools

- Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
 (and their native analytics) 

- CapCut / Meta Edits / Premiere 

· Canva · 

- Notion or ClickUp 

- a cross-posting tool like Later



Compensation & Setup

- $900–$1,000/month

- Full-time, 40h/week, remote

- 14 days paid leave per year



To Apply - Required

Answer only from your own experience, and name the real company or account each answer comes from. We're not asking what you would do - we're asking what you actually did. Generic or AI-written answers that don't tie to real work won't move forward.



1. Describe a short-form video you edited at a named company or account. What was the raw material, what did you change and in which tool, and what was it for?

2. Take one creator you sourced and worked with at a company on your CV — who were they (handle or follower band), what did you pay, what usage rights did you agree, and how did the content perform?

3. Tell us about a time you turned down or dropped a creator or audience that looked good on paper — big follower count - because you judged it wasn't worth it. What told you?

4. One piece of content or campaign from your CV that drove a measurable result — the numbers, and where they came from.



Please include your salary expectation and availability.

title: Part-Time Script Writer for TikTok & Reels | AI Tools Welcome
description:
We’re hiring a part-time script writer to turn our content ideas and creative direction into engaging short-form video scripts for a hair-care brand.



You won’t be starting from a blank page. We’ll provide ideas, explanations, reference videos, and direction. Your job is to understand what we’re trying to say and turn it into a clear, natural script.



AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini are welcome and can be part of your everyday workflow. We’re looking for someone who can guide those tools, recognize strong output, and edit it into something ready to use.



What you’ll do:

• Review our recorded explanations, notes, and reference videos.

• Turn the ideas we’ve already discussed into finished scripts.

• Use AI models to help draft, develop, and refine scripts.

• Write compelling hooks and keep the pacing engaging.

• Make the language sound natural to a US audience.

• Apply feedback and deliver scripts by agreed deadlines.



You’re a good fit if you:

• Write clear, natural English.

• Can turn rough or spoken ideas into concise, engaging writing.

• Understand what makes people keep watching TikToks, Reels, and Shorts.

• Are comfortable prompting AI tools and improving their output.

• Pay attention to details and communicate reliably.



Experience with beauty, hair care, ecommerce, or short-form content is a plus.



AI can help with the writing, but you’re responsible for the final quality. Scripts should follow our direction, sound human, and avoid invented product claims.



Pay and schedule:

• Part-time role to start.

• Starting base pay: US$200 per month.

• Performance bonuses available, up to US$600.

• Workload and deadlines will be agreed before starting.



How to apply:

Send us a message on OnlineJobs.ph with the words “green light.”



We’ll reply with a Google Form for you to complete. You must complete the form to be considered.

You’ll work directly with the founder, research different approaches, make technical recommendations, and own projects through development, launch, and ongoing improvement.



What you should be able to do



- Build complete applications: usable interfaces, backend services, databases, authentication, and deployment.

- You question results that look wrong and trace problems to their cause.

- You use AI development tools effectively and can understand, explain, and debug the code they produce.

- You make practical decisions about what to build, what to buy, and what to simplify.

You should enjoy both the creative work of building something new and the careful work of making it dependable.

title: Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager |Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote
description:
Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager



Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company operating multiple Shopify stores across several countries and processing significant transaction volumes through multiple payment providers.



We are looking for a highly capable Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager to professionalize and take ownership of our finance function.



This is NOT a junior bookkeeping position.



We already have finance/accounting activities taking place inside the company. We need a senior finance professional who can ensure that our numbers are accurate, our controls are strong and management has reliable financial information for decision-making.



Your Mission



Build a finance function that the founder can trust.



You will assess our current finance processes, identify weaknesses, improve controls and reporting, and oversee the people performing recurring finance work.



Responsibilities



* Own financial reporting and financial accuracy

* Review and improve our current finance processes

* Oversee bookkeeping and accounting workflows

* Review reconciliations across banks and payment processors

* Ensure Shopify/order data reconciles correctly with financial records

* Monitor payment processor settlements and fees

* Review supplier payments and COGS

* Improve expense categorization and controls

* Monitor refunds, chargebacks and payment-related losses

* Produce reliable monthly P&L reporting

* Produce consolidated and store-level management reporting

* Develop cash-flow reporting and forecasting

* Build budgets and forecasts

* Identify unusual financial movements and discrepancies

* Establish appropriate approval and financial control processes

* Review the work of junior finance/accounting team members

* Improve month-end closing procedures

* Work with external accountants, tax advisers and other specialists where required

* Help management understand profitability and financial performance

* Identify opportunities for financial automation and better systems



E-Commerce Complexity



Experience with high-volume e-commerce is strongly preferred.



Our environment may include:



* Multiple Shopify stores

* Multiple currencies

* Multiple countries

* Stripe

* Shopify Payments

* PayPal

* Klarna and other payment methods

* Refunds

* Chargebacks

* Supplier payments

* Advertising spend

* FX

* Payment processor fees



You should be comfortable reconciling complex transaction flows rather than only traditional invoice-based businesses.



What We Are Looking For



* Strong accounting/finance foundation

* Significant experience in financial control, finance management or senior accounting

* Excellent reconciliation skills

* Strong management reporting ability

* Experience creating or improving financial controls

* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Experience with accounting software such as Xero or QuickBooks

* High attention to detail

* Strong analytical ability

* Ability to investigate discrepancies independently

* Ability to review and challenge the work of others

* Strong written English



CPA/ACCA/CIMA or comparable professional qualifications are highly valued but not automatically required if your experience is exceptional.



What We Are NOT Looking For



This is not suitable for someone whose experience is primarily:



* Data entry

* Basic bookkeeping

* Accounts payable only

* Virtual assistance

* Producing reports without understanding the underlying numbers



We need someone capable of owning and controlling a finance function, not simply processing transactions.



What Success Looks Like



Management can confidently answer:



* How profitable are we?

* Which stores are most profitable?

* What is our real COGS?

* Where is our cash?

* What are our payment processor balances?

* Are all transactions reconciled?

* What are our major financial risks?

* How are actual results performing against forecast?



And most importantly: management can trust the answers.



Application



Please answer:



1. What is the largest company, measured by annual revenue or transaction volume, for which you have personally managed or controlled finance?

2. Describe the most complex reconciliation environment you have worked with.

3. Have you worked with Shopify, Stripe, PayPal or similar payment processors? Explain exactly what you were responsible for.

4. Tell us about a significant financial discrepancy or control problem you personally discovered. How did you find it and what happened?

5. Which financial reports did you personally prepare or review each month?

6. Have you managed or reviewed the work of other accountants/bookkeepers? How many?

7. Which accounting qualifications do you hold?

8. Which accounting systems are you strongest with?

9. What is your current availability and expected monthly compensation for a full-time position?



Begin your application with FINANCIAL CONTROL.

System Testing: Perform testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and equipment.

title: Short-Form Editor / Content Clipper
description:
Full-Time Short-Form Editor: Storyteller, not button-pusher



What this job is

You’ll own one full clip account, end to end. You get hours of raw footage every week: podcasts, calls, livestreams, business moments, everyday life. You find the moments that make a stranger stop scrolling, watch to the end, and feel something. You edit them, give them their cover and caption, post them, and watch what works.



This is a full-time role, and it’s repetitive by design. You’ll do the same kind of work every day. The right person sees that as a craft: clip 300 should be better than clip 1, not lazier.



What you’re responsible for



The account: its look, its feeling, its consistency

Picking the moments and editing the clips

Covers, captions and posting

Watching the numbers, learning what works, and doing more of it



You’re the right person if you:



Feel the edit before you make it. You know which shot, which song and which pause will make someone feel respect, laugh, or think “that’s me.”

See every clip as a story. Even 15 seconds has a setup, a moment and a landing.

Know that the first second d
 everything. If it doesn’t create a question in the viewer’s head, they’re gone.

Understand B-roll. Footage that matches what’s being said, not footage that just looks nice.

Understand music. The track sets the feeling, and you know exactly when it drops in and when it cuts out.

Are obsessed with framing. Where the face sits, what’s in the background, what’s cropped out. A clean frame says more than any effect.

Use silence. A pause before the line is often the whole edit.

Edit by subtraction. Your best work is the edit nobody notices.

Think like an owner. It’s your account. When a clip flops you want to know why, and when one hits you want to know why too.



You’re not the right person if:



Your style is zooms, emojis and sound effects on every word

You edit every video the same way, from a template

You need someone to tell you which moment to cut

You get bored doing the same type of work every day

You want to edit and hand it off, without caring what happens after it’s posted



How to apply

Send:



3 short-form clips you edited (any creator)



You have potential to earn more based on performance.

title: AI Video Creator for TikTok Shop (Base Pay + 10% Commission Share)
description:
Hiring 5 AI Content Creators | TikTok Shop | Base Pay + 10% Profit Share



I’m looking for 5 talented, creative, and independent AI content creators to join my TikTok Shop operation, which has generated over $700,000 in sales.



Your job will be to create short, realistic AI-generated clothing videos for TikTok Shop.



This is a long-term opportunity for people who are genuinely interested in AI content creation, enjoy experimenting with new ideas, and want to earn more as their content performs better.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll create short, 6–15 second AI-generated videos promoting clothing products.



The goal is to produce content that looks and feels like it was filmed by a real person using a smartphone.



We are NOT creating generic “AI slop,” cartoons, or animated videos. We want highly realistic content that is nearly indistinguishable from real footage.



You’ll be responsible for:



- Studying proven, high-performing TikTok content styles.



- Creatively adapting those styles to your assigned AI character and clothing products.



- Generating realistic AI images and videos using the tools provided.



- Experimenting with different ideas, outfits, camera angles, and content approaches.



- Learning from feedback and continuously improving the quality of your work.



What I’ll Provide



You won’t be starting from scratch. I’ll give you everything you need to succeed:



- Proven content strategies: I’ll show you exactly what types of videos are currently performing well and generating sales.



- AI tools: I’ll provide access to the tools you’ll need to create high-quality images and videos.



- Training: I’ll teach you how to use these tools effectively and get the best possible results.



- Regular feedback: I’ll personally review your content multiple times per week and help you improve.



- Direct support: My DMs are open 7 days a week for questions, advice, and guidance.



- Creator community: You’ll be part of a private group with other creators, where you can share ideas, learn from each other, and improve together.



You’ll have plenty of guidance and support, but you’ll also have the freedom to develop your own creative approach.



IMPORTANT: You Must Be Able to Think Independently



This is probably the most important requirement.



I’m not looking for someone who needs to be told exactly what video to create every day.



I’ll show you what’s working, explain why it’s working, and give you the tools and knowledge to recreate that success.



Your job is to connect the dots.



For example, if I show you a clothing video that’s generating lots of sales, I expect you to think about how you could adapt that concept to your own AI character and clothing product.



You should be comfortable coming up with ideas, testing different approaches, solving problems, and making creative decisions independently.



I will provide regular feedback and guidance, but I won’t be giving you step-by-step instructions for every single video.



If you need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day, this probably isn’t the right position for you.



However, if you’re naturally creative, resourceful, and enjoy figuring things out, I think you’ll love this opportunity.



Requirements



- Previous experience creating AI-generated images and videos.



- A strong eye for realism, detail, and visual quality.



- Creative thinking and the ability to adapt existing ideas into new content.



- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



- Willingness to experiment, accept feedback, and continuously improve.



- Good communication skills and a reliable work ethic.



Experience creating TikTok Shop content is a bonus, but not required. I’ll teach you what you need to know about TikTok Shop.



Compensation & Growth Opportunities:



Base pay: $0.30 USD per completed video + 10% profit share from the earnings generated by your videos.



This means you’re rewarded not just for producing content, but also for creating videos that actually generate sales.



The better your content performs, the more you can earn.



Example Monthly Earnings:



Let’s say you consistently create 18 videos per day and your videos generate $50,000 in total monthly sales, with an average affiliate commission rate of 15%.



Here’s what your monthly earnings would look like:



Base pay: 18 videos × 30 days × $0.30 = $162



Total affiliate commissions generated: $50,000 × 15% = $7,500



Your 10% profit share: $750



Total monthly earnings: $912 USD



And that’s just one example. The more sales your videos generate, the higher your earnings. There’s no fixed earning ceiling.



Your earnings will depend on your output and how well your videos perform.



There are also opportunities for:



- Higher base pay as you demonstrate consistent quality and performance.



- Increased profit share for creators who deliver strong results.



- Higher-paying projects beyond clothing content for our best-performing creators.



- Long-term growth within an established, profitable TikTok Shop operation.



I’m looking for people who want to improve their skills, become excellent AI creators, and grow alongside the business.



How to Apply:



Please include the following in your application:



1) Your AI experience: Which AI image and video generation tools have you used?



2) Your previous work: Share 2–3 examples of realistic AI-generated videos you’ve created.



3) Your creative approach: If I showed you a successful TikTok clothing video and gave you a different clothing product and AI character, how would you approach adapting it?



4) Your availability: How many hours per day can you dedicate to this role?



I’m especially interested in seeing examples of realistic AI content that could genuinely pass as real recorded footage.



I’m hiring 5 creators and looking for people who are serious about developing their skills and producing excellent work.



If that sounds like you, I’d love to hear from you.

title: California Transaction Coordinator
description:
I am looking for an experienced **California Real Estate Transaction Coordinator** who is fully comfortable managing the day-to-day details of a residential real estate transaction from contract to close.



This is **not a general virtual assistant position**. I need someone who understands the nuances of California real estate transactions, knows how to anticipate what comes next, and can communicate confidently and professionally with real estate agents, escrow officers, lenders, title representatives, and other parties involved in the transaction.



I am looking for someone who **takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do**. You should be able to review a file, identify missing documents or outstanding items, recognize approaching deadlines, follow up appropriately, and bring potential problems to my attention before they become problems.



You must have strong working knowledge of **California residential purchase contracts and associated C.A.R. forms**, including disclosures, contingency timelines, earnest money, inspections, appraisal and loan timelines, requests for repair, contingency removals, demands to close, cancellations, escrow documentation, and closing requirements.



You must be comfortable using:



- **SkySlope — required**

- **GLIDE — required**

- **Gmail — required**

- ZipForm experience preferred

- SISU experience is a plus

- **Nekst experience is a major plus**



You must also be comfortable communicating directly with escrow and real estate agents and understand what information should be requested, when follow-up is appropriate, and when an issue needs to be escalated.



### Schedule



This position requires availability **Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time**.



I am **not looking for someone who is simultaneously managing several other clients during these hours**. I want someone who is interested in working with me specifically and becoming an integral part of my transaction coordination operation.



You may have outside commitments outside of our scheduled hours, but during your working hours with me, I expect my transactions to be your primary responsibility.



### Ideal Candidate



The right person will:



- Have significant experience with **California residential transactions**

- Be completely comfortable functioning in a transaction coordination role

- Understand the transaction process rather than simply following a checklist

- Know California C.A.R. contracts and associated forms

- Be proactive and highly organized

- Be able to manage multiple active transactions and priorities

- Communicate professionally with agents, escrow, title, and lenders

- Follow up without being reminded

- Identify missing documents and outstanding requirements independently

- Track deadlines and contingencies accurately

- Have excellent written and spoken English

- Have reliable high-speed internet and backup internet/power

- Be comfortable working Pacific Time hours long-term



I am looking for a **long-term working relationship with someone I can trust and rely on**, not someone looking to add another client to a large portfolio.



When applying, please tell me:



1. How many years you have worked specifically with **California real estate transactions**

2. Which California C.A.R. forms you work with regularly

3. Your experience with SkySlope, GLIDE, Gmail, ZipForm, SISU, and Nekst

4. Whether you have worked directly with escrow officers and agents

5. Your current work schedule and whether you currently have other clients or employers

6. Whether you can consistently work **8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time**

7. How many active transactions you have managed at one time

8. Your hourly rate

9. Please describe a situation where you noticed a transaction issue before the agent or TC brought it to your attention and explain what you did.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – YouTube Shorts, TikTok & Reels (Part-Time)
description:
Amy's is looking for a short-form video editor to join our team part-time. Work starts on an assignment basis. If you show and prove to be an asset, we will ask you to become salaried.



Our long-form YouTube travel videos (Mr Feast) are the main product. Your job is the short-form engine around them: shorts, Reels, and TikToks that work as advertisements for the long-form videos and send viewers to watch the full video.



What you'll do:

- Cut long-form travel videos into short-form clips (mostly 60 seconds or less, vertical 9:16)

- Build each short around a strong hook and an open loop — tease the answer, don't give it away; the full answer lives in the long video

- Add big, clean, readable captions throughout and end every short with a call to action to watch the full video

- Deliver polished, publish-ready shorts at professional standards — clean cuts, smooth pacing, balanced audio. Choppy or rushed work will not be accepted

- Hit agreed turnaround times consistently (volume matters in this role)



What we're looking for:

- Proven experience editing YouTube Shorts, TikTok, or Reels (portfolio of shorts required)

- Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar — tell us your stack

- You understand short-form hooks, retention, and pacing for a Western audience (Canada/USA)

- Clean, modern editing style — no overdone effects, flashy transitions, or cluttered graphics

- Good written English, reliable internet, your own editing setup



Hours & pay: Part-time to start (hours vary by assignment). Hourly pay at market rate, based on your skill and experience — please include your rate when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS FIRST:

Most applicants skim job posts. We need people who don't. To prove you read this entire post, start your application message with this exact phrase: "SHORTS Amy's sent me"

Applications that don't start with those exact words will not be reviewed. No exceptions, no hard feelings — we just need people who follow instructions. (Starting with SHORTS tells us you're applying for the short-form editor role.)



Then answer these 5 questions in your application:

1. Please share links to 3 short-form videos you've edited (Shorts, TikTok, or Reels).

2. What editing software do you use?

3. How many finished shorts can you realistically deliver per week?

4. In 2–3 sentences: how do you make a short that sends viewers to the full long video instead of giving everything away in the short itself?

5. What hours (Philippine time) are you generally available to work?



TEST PROJECT (required — we hire based on this):

Create ONE vertical short (30–59 seconds) that works as an advertisement for a longer travel video titled: "Could I Live in Taipei? — The Cost of Living Test (vs Vancouver)".

Requirements: hook in the first 2 seconds; big readable captions throughout; tease the cost-of-living comparison but do NOT reveal the final verdict (that's in the long video); end card / closing line: "Full video on YouTube — link in bio." You may use stock footage and AI/text-to-speech voiceover — you do not need to appear on camera. No watermarks.

We judge on professional, publish-ready standards: hook strength, pacing, caption quality, and how well the short makes us want to watch the full video. AI-generated spam is an instant reject — we can tell.

Submit the finished video file or a viewable link with your application.



TEST VIDEO PAYMENT TERMS (please read before submitting):

The test video you submit with your application is unpaid. However — if we select your video because we like it and want to use it, we will pay you $20-$25 for it. Simple as that: submit your best work, and if it's good enough to publish, you get paid.

Job Type: Part-Time, Long-Term (Potential for Full-Time)  

Compensation: Negotiable Based on Experience



 About OBSIDEX



OBSIDEX is a growing U.S.-based e-commerce brand specializing in 3D-printed replacement parts, repair accessories, and practical consumer products sold primarily on Amazon.



We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented **Amazon Product Research & Listing Specialist** to help expand our product catalog.



The ideal candidate can independently research profitable product opportunities, analyze competition, create optimized Amazon listings, and design professional listing images.



This is a long-term opportunity with room to increase hours and responsibilities as the business grows.



 Key Responsibilities



 1. Product Research & Opportunity Analysis

- Identify profitable product opportunities, focusing on replacement parts, functional accessories, and niche consumer products.

- Analyze Amazon demand, competition, pricing history, estimated sales volume, and customer reviews.

- Use Keepa and other research tools to evaluate potential products.

- Estimate profitability, including manufacturing costs, Amazon fees, and fulfillment expenses.

- Identify underserved markets, competitor weaknesses, and potential product improvements.

- Present findings in organized research reports with supporting data and recommendations.



 2. Amazon Listing Creation & Optimization

- Create and manage new private-label product listings in Amazon Seller Central.

- Write SEO-optimized titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend keywords.

- Conduct keyword research to improve organic visibility and conversions.

- Accurately complete product attributes, dimensions, compatibility details, and other listing information.

- Improve existing listings based on performance, customer feedback, and competitor analysis.



3. Product Image Editing & Design

- Create professional Amazon listing images using Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or similar design software.

- Edit real product photographs, including background removal, lighting adjustments, and image enhancement.

- Design informative infographics highlighting product features, dimensions, compatibility, benefits, and installation.

- Create lifestyle images and secondary listing graphics that improve product presentation.

- Maintain consistent branding and follow Amazon's listing image requirements.



Adobe Photoshop experience is strongly preferred.**



 4. AI Tools & Workflow Optimization

- Use tools such as ChatGPT and AI-assisted design software to improve productivity.

- Leverage AI for research assistance, keyword organization, listing content, and image development.

- Verify all AI-generated information for accuracy.

- Ensure product specifications, compatibility claims, and images accurately represent the physical product.



 5. Organization & Reporting

- Maintain organized spreadsheets tracking product research, listing development, and launches.

- Provide regular progress updates and clearly communicate research findings.

- Follow established workflows and standard operating procedures.

- Manage assigned tasks independently and meet agreed-upon deadlines.



 Required Qualifications



- Proven experience with **Amazon Seller Central and creating new private-label product listings**.

- Strong Amazon product research and competitor analysis skills.

- Experience using Keepa and Amazon keyword research tools.

- Ability to evaluate demand, competition, and potential profitability.

- Experience creating professional Amazon product images and infographics.

- Proficiency with Photoshop, Canva, or similar design software.

- Strong understanding of Amazon SEO and listing optimization.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.



 Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with replacement parts, 3D-printed products, or niche accessories.

- Experience with Amazon FBA and fulfillment fee calculations.

- Advanced Adobe Photoshop skills.

- Experience using ChatGPT and other AI productivity tools.

- Ability to develop reusable listing image templates.

- Experience researching long-tail, low-competition product opportunities.

- Familiarity with product compatibility and intellectual-property considerations.



*3D printing experience is a plus but is not required.*



 What We're Looking For



We value **quality research and profitable product opportunities over simply producing a high volume of listings**.



Our goal is to build a sustainable catalog of products, including both strong sellers and smaller, consistent long-tail products.



We're looking for someone who:

- Thinks critically and uses data to support recommendations.

- Takes initiative and solves problems independently.

- Produces accurate, professional, high-quality work.

- Is comfortable learning new tools and improving workflows.

- Wants to grow with a developing e-commerce brand.



Schedule & Growth Opportunities



This position will begin part-time, with the potential to increase to **25+ hours per week and eventually full-time**, depending on performance and business growth.



We're interested in building a long-term working relationship with someone who can take on additional responsibilities as OBSIDEX expands.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Amazon Experience**  

Briefly describe your experience with Amazon Seller Central, private-label listings, and product research.



2. Listing Examples**  

Provide links to at least two Amazon private-label listings you personally worked on, if authorized to share them. Explain your contributions.



3. Image Design Portfolio**  

Share examples of Amazon listing images or infographics you personally designed, preferably using Photoshop.



4. Product Research Process**  

Explain how you identify profitable Amazon product opportunities, including the tools and metrics you use.



5. Software Experience**  

List your experience with Keepa, Photoshop, Canva, ChatGPT, keyword research tools, and other relevant software.



6. Availability & Rate**  

Provide your preferred hourly rate, weekly availability, and whether you're interested in increasing your hours over time.



Please ensure all submitted work samples accurately reflect your own contributions.**



Hiring Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical skills assessment** covering product research, Amazon listing creation, and product-image design.



This assessment will help us evaluate your skills and determine whether the position is a good long-term fit.



We're looking for a reliable, motivated individual who wants to become an important part of OBSIDEX as we continue expanding our product catalog.

title: EXPERIENCED EDITOR — LONG-TERM FREELANCE (NOW: up to $1k per month//LATER: up to $2-3k per month)
description:
We're looking for one experienced, reliable editor interested in building a long-term creative working relationship.



Please do not apply without reading the entire job description. 

This is **not** a standard role and we are very particular in who we are engaging with. 



The position begins with spoken-audio only editing, but is intended to expand quickly into visual enhancements, humor, and broader creative responsibilities. The role has a lot of creative room and freedom. 



This work is unique in the sense that much of it is templated and, for an experienced editor, is straightforward/simple for the higher pay rate. However, the challenge is that we have a very specific creative style that will need to be learned at the beginning. So, this isn't a role for someone unwilling to learn or listen to feedback to improve. 



Our goal is to develop one editor who can learn our established style, work increasingly independently, and grow with us over several years. 



Therefore, we are taking the application process seriously and hope you do too. 



--------------------------



WORK & COMPENSATION



• Approximately 1–2 videos weekly, usually 15–30 minutes each

• Flexible, project-based work with variable weekly volume

• Paid trial: $50 for one video

• Starting audio editing: $50–75 per video

• Audio + creative enhancements: $75–125 per video

• Additional production work and future increases negotiated separately



HOURS & ESTIMATED HOURLY VALUE



• Audio-only: $50–$75 per video, approximately 1–3 hours ($17–$75/hour).

• Audio + creative enhancements: $75–$125 per video, approximately 2–5 hours ($15–$62.50/hour).

• Maximum weekly workload: Approximately 10 hours, earning up to $250 ($25/hour).



These are estimates to show the breakdown hourly, not fixed hourly wages or strict time limits. We prioritize quality and are open to negotiating workload, deadlines, and compensation as you learn the role. 



An experienced editor should think the work is very easy and straightforward after getting the style down, since it's only adding and not creating. Therefore, the pay is quite high for the true expected work after learning. We are willing to pay for quality and true creative thought.



----------------------



COMPENSATION STRUCTURE 



Compensation includes a guaranteed base payment and a performance bonus based on accuracy, editing quality, independence, and required corrections after submission. 



For example, at the expanded creative-editing level:

•  4 videos per month: Up to $500

• 6 videos per month: Up to $750

• 8 videos per month: Up to $1,000



These figures are just explains to show our current budget. Our budget can grow substantially beyond this as responsibilities and business revenue expand. We anticipate $2,000–3,000 USD over the next year if an editor can demonstrate reliability and discernment. 



Each assignment's scope, guaranteed payment, potential bonus, and deadline conditions will be agreed upon in advance. Which is why we need someone willing to really put in communication effort and thought. 



-----------------------



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS



• English: C2 or native/bilingual proficiency, with excellent comprehension of conversational English, humor, and nuance. Evidence required.

• Experience: Proven spoken-audio or podcast editing experience, including seamless dialogue cuts and crossfades.

• Software: Experience with DaVinci Resolve or comparable professional software. All assignments use DaVinci Resolve. CapCut-only experience does not qualify.

• Reliability: Verifiable experience meeting deadlines, working independently, and maintaining professional client relationships.



This is not an entry-level position. Please do not apply without real editing experience to demonstrate.



----------------------------



THE WORK & CREATIVE GROWTH



Initially, you'll clean spoken audio by removing mistakes, filler words, unnecessary pauses, and distracting breaths while preserving natural speech. This is very easy and repetitive work to start getting comfortable with the role.



Detailed training materials and examples are provided to teach our specific workflow, so you're never guessing.



After demonstrating accuracy and independence through a few assignments, we'd introduce:

• Simple sound effects, GIFs, text, and humor

• Simple animations and creative visual enhancements

• Eventually, writing, short creation and other production work



The work is already assembled or templated, so you're never actually doing a full 15-30 minute video yourself but enhancing the existing. The challenge is learning where creative elements belong, why they improve the message, and when they're unnecessary.



We want someone who can develop that judgment and gradually reduce the amount of oversight required.



--------------



DEADLINES & FEEDBACK



• 1 video: 24-hour turnaround

• 2 videos: 48-hour turnaround



Assignments are communicated in advance, generally midweek. You will never be given an assignment out of nowhere with a 24-hour expectation.



We review submissions, provide feedback, and expect previous corrections to be understood and applied independently. Consistent improvement is essential.



-----------------------



OUR CONTENT (IMPORTANT) 



Our material explores astrology, tarot, spirituality, energy work, sound healing, and other esoteric or pseudoscientific subjects.

Your personal relationship with these subjects matters. Eventually, you'll need to understand their meaning well enough to contribute relevant humor, visuals, and creative ideas.



We're looking for genuine interest and respect for the material, rather than someone simply willing to tolerate it. We believe that long-term creative work becomes difficult when someone gradually loses respect for what they're producing. Please do not apply with a generic response to your thoughts about this work. We need real engagement to understand your positioning, even if imperfect for the role. Explain your rationale for applying anyway. 



---------------



TO APPLY



Please answer the following thoughtfully:



1. Experience: Share verifiable examples of previous spoken-audio editing, the software used, and your specific responsibilities.

2. English: Confirm your proficiency and provide evidence of C2 or native/bilingual comprehension.

3. Reliability: Describe your previous long-term client relationships, current availability, and a situation where you independently resolved a difficult work problem.

4. Content compatibility: What are your actual thoughts and experiences with astrology, spirituality, tarot, energy work, or similar topics? Could you see yourself enjoying and respecting creative work involving these subjects for several years? Please be candid, including any reservations. The more detail and honesty here the better.

5. Explain why a long-term role suits you better than short-term or temporary work. If possible, don't give a generic answer here. Everyone wants a working relationship that has consistency and trust and longterm easy work, but why do you feel you can actually put in the effort to actually get the payoff of this type of unique role?



----------------



START DATE: JANUARY, 2027



We're looking for one reliable person to work with for years, ideally someone who prefers developing a lasting working relationship over constantly pursuing new clients. This type of person is fairly rare in the freelancing world. 



We value direct communication, independent judgment, and the confidence to discuss problems, expectations, and compensation openly. So if you have issues and you communicate it honestly in your application, that's more appealing to us than someone who pretends they have no preference or issues. Honesty above all creates mutual trust and respect over time, not avoidance. 



We don't want someone perfect, we want someone real. 



Specific, thoughtful applications matter more than polished or AI-generated responses.

title: YouTube Thumbnail & Graphic Designer (Part-Time)
description:
Amy's is looking for a graphic designer to join our team part-time. Work starts on an assignment basis. If you show and prove to be an asset, we will ask you to become salaried.



We run a YouTube travel channel (Mr Feast) and a Vancouver party/decor store (Amy's on Davie). Your work is the packaging that makes people click and buy: YouTube thumbnails, ad creatives, and social graphics.



What you'll do:

- Design YouTube thumbnails that earn the click — clear at small size, strong contrast, minimal text, real curiosity

- Design Meta/Facebook ad creatives and social media graphics for the store

- Occasionally design simple print pieces (one-page flyers / product lookbooks)

- Follow brand direction and feedback, deliver clean files on agreed turnaround



What we're looking for:

- A portfolio that includes YouTube thumbnails you've designed (required) — show us click-worthy work, not just pretty work

- Proficient in Photoshop (Canva, Illustrator, or Figma in addition is a plus) — tell us your stack

- You understand what makes people click: contrast, emotion, curiosity gap, readability at phone size

- Clean, modern design for a Western audience (Canada/USA) — no cluttered, dated, or overdone graphics

- Good written English, reliable internet, your own setup



Hours & pay: Part-time to start (hours vary by assignment). Hourly pay at market rate, based on your skill and experience — please include your rate when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS FIRST:

Most applicants skim job posts. We need people who don't. To prove you read this entire post, start your application message with this exact phrase: "DESIGN Amy's sent me"

Applications that don't start with those exact words will not be reviewed. No exceptions, no hard feelings — we just need people who follow instructions. (Starting with DESIGN tells us you're applying for the designer role.)



Then answer these 5 questions in your application:

1. Please share your portfolio, highlighting YouTube thumbnails you've designed.

2. What design software do you use?

3. In 2–3 sentences: what makes a YouTube thumbnail get clicked instead of scrolled past?

4. How fast can you turn around a set of 5 thumbnails?

5. What hours (Philippine time) are you generally available to work?



TEST PROJECT (required — we hire based on this):

Design these 3 pieces and submit them with your application (image files or viewable links):

1. A YouTube thumbnail for: "Could I Live in Taipei? (Cost of Living vs Vancouver)"

2. A YouTube thumbnail for: "I Run My Vancouver Store From a Café in Taiwan"

3. One square (1:1) Meta ad creative for: "Christmas decor for your business — bulk & wholesale pricing at Amy's on Davie, Vancouver."

Thumbnail specs: must stay readable at small phone size, maximum 3–4 words of text on the thumbnail itself, strong contrast, no clutter. You may use free stock imagery. We judge on click-appeal, clarity at small size, and how well you followed the brief. AI-generated spam is an instant reject — we can tell.



TEST PROJECT PAYMENT TERMS (please read before submitting):

The test designs you submit with your application are unpaid. However — if we select your designs because we like them and want to use them, we will pay you $20-$25 for the set. Simple as that: submit your best work, and if it's good enough to publish, you get paid.

title: Australian Accountant – Bookkeeping, BAS and Tax
description:
Accountant (Bookkeeping & BAS)

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Australian Accounting Practice



About the Role

Cruz & Co, a Sydney-based accounting and tax practice, is seeking an experienced Accountant (Bookkeeping & BAS) to join its team remotely from the Philippines.

This role combines year-end accounting and tax compliance with ongoing bookkeeping and Business Activity Statement (BAS) preparation for a portfolio of approximately 30 business clients.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience preparing financial statements, tax returns, and BAS, along with strong bookkeeping skills and knowledge of Australian tax and compliance requirements.



Key Responsibilities



Year-End Accounting & Tax Compliance

Prepare financial statements, tax workpapers, and tax returns for companies, trusts, and partnerships.

Prepare bank reconciliations, fixed asset schedules, depreciation journals, and loan workpapers.

Reconcile GST, BAS, PAYG, and general ledger accounts.

Prepare tax calculations, tax journals, and supporting documentation.

Address reviewer feedback and client queries, ensuring accurate and timely completion of work.



Bookkeeping

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping for approximately 30 clients using Xero and QuickBooks Online.

Review and code bank transactions and perform monthly or quarterly reconciliations.

Process accounts payable and receivable where required.

Manage payroll, Single Touch Payroll (STP), and superannuation for applicable clients.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records.



BAS & Activity Statements

Prepare quarterly and monthly Business Activity Statements (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS).

Reconcile GST and PAYG withholding against accounting records and payroll reports.

Coordinate client approvals and ensure timely lodgment through the tax agent portal.

Monitor lodgment deadlines and follow up on outstanding client information.

Prepare annual GST and fuel tax credit reconciliations where applicable.



Client Communication & Workflow Management

Request missing information and follow up with clients promptly.

Maintain accurate job statuses and time records in the practice management system.

Identify and escalate potential compliance issues to the reviewing accountant.

Manage deadlines while maintaining accurate, well-documented workpapers.



Requirements

At least 2 years of accounting experience preparing financial statements and tax returns for companies, trusts, and partnerships.

Hands-on experience with bookkeeping and BAS preparation using Xero.

Knowledge of Australian GST, PAYG withholding and instalments, STP, superannuation guarantee, and Division 7A.

Experience preparing tax workpapers and reconciling ATO accounts.

Strong written English and the ability to prepare clear, well-organized workpapers.

Excellent attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple clients and meet recurring compliance deadlines.

Australian public practice experience is preferred. Candidates with a CPA qualification or currently studying towards one may also be considered without Australian accounting experience.



Preferred Qualifications & Experience

Degree in Accounting or a related field.

CA or CPA qualification, or progress towards one.

Experience with Reportance and QuickBooks Online.

Registered BAS Agent experience or familiarity with Australian BAS lodgment requirements.



Working Arrangements

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Remote, based in the Philippines

Working Hours: Sydney business hours, approximately 6:00 AM–2:00 PM Philippine time during Australian daylight saving and 7:00 AM–3:00 PM otherwise.

Systems: Xero, QuickBooks Online, Reportance, Google Workspace, and practice management software.

Workload: Approximately 30 bookkeeping clients, alongside year-end compliance and tax preparation.



The role requires strict adherence to client confidentiality and data security policies. All client information must remain within the firm's approved systems, with no local copies stored on personal devices.



Candidates should be comfortable managing workload peaks around BAS due dates and year-end tax lodgment deadlines.



How to Apply

If you have a strong accounting background, hands-on Xero experience, and knowledge of Australian accounting and tax compliance, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your CV highlighting your relevant accounting experience, software proficiency, and qualifications.

title: Australian SMSF Accountant
description:
SMSF Accountant

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Australian Accounting Practice



About the Role

Cruz & Co, a Sydney-based accounting and tax practice, is seeking an experienced SMSF Accountant to manage a portfolio of approximately 150 self-managed super funds (SMSFs) from setup through annual compliance, audit, and lodgment.

This role requires strong technical knowledge of Australian SMSF accounting and taxation, advanced proficiency in Simple Fund 360 (SF360), and the ability to manage the full compliance process independently.

You will report directly to the Principal and work closely with clients, referral partners, and independent SMSF auditors.



Key Responsibilities

Fund Setup & Maintenance

Set up new SMSFs in Simple Fund 360, including member details, bank feeds, investments, properties, and auditor information.

Perform annual roll-forwards and verify opening balances against prior-year audited financial statements.

Maintain consistent fund setup procedures and checklists.



SMSF Accounting & Annual Returns

Code and reconcile bank accounts, limited recourse borrowing arrangements (LRBAs), and investment accounts, including international shares and cryptocurrency.

Prepare year-end journals for investment revaluations, property depreciation, rental income, accruals, contributions, and fees.

Prepare SMSF financial statements, member statements, operating statements, and annual returns.

Calculate fund tax liabilities, including exempt current pension income (ECPI) where applicable.

Reconcile ATO Integrated Tax Account (ITA) and Integrated Client Account (ICA) statements, including PAYG installments and tax payable.



Audit Coordination

Prepare complete audit files with supporting documents, including invoices, investment statements, valuations, and property leases.

Submit files to independent SMSF auditors and respond promptly to audit queries.

Maintain audit documentation requirements and update internal checklists as needed.



Client & Stakeholder Communication

Request outstanding information from clients and referral partners and follow up until received.

Arrange property valuations in advance of reporting deadlines.

Identify and escalate compliance concerns, including in-house asset breaches, early or duplicate withdrawals, and contribution cap issues.

title: AI Automation Developer (Claude): build the AI back office for a Swiss experience business
description:
**AI Automation Developer (Claude): build the AI back office for a Swiss experience business**



**Read this first. If your application doesn't start with a video link, I won't open it.**

A CV is welcome, but it goes below the video.



**About us**

Axtra runs urban axe throwing and axe making in Zürich, Switzerland. We're growing fast and plan more locations. Our admin side already runs partly on AI. We have an AI reservation assistant called "Sara", daily reports and Google Sheets automations, all built on Claude. Now we want someone to make it bulletproof, document it, and help us turn it into a package we can sell to other businesses.



**What you'll build**

1. **Sara, our AI reservation assistant.** She should:

   - Answer customer
s in the customer's language (mostly German and English), using our real prices and rules.

   - Send quotes for group and corporate events.

   - Order pizzas for groups from our pizza supplier.

   - Help our manager with the coach schedule. She checks bookings against the rota and flags shifts that don't need two coaches, following the owner's staffing rules. When more bookings come in, she flags the shift again.

   - Draft replies to Google and TripAdvisor reviews.

   - Escalate anything outside the rules to a human, such as discounts, complaints or unusual requests. She never makes things up.

2. **A daily one-pager for the owner.** It shows revenue, expenses, ad spend and bookings in one place, built inside Claude. Sources: Bexio (accounting, the source of truth), FareHarbor (bookings), Meta ads via Windsor.ai, and our Google Sheet.

3. **Integrations.** Connect our waiver and check-in, in-venue games and signups, so every player's details and results land in one place.

4. **The video content pipeline.** Fix our short-form and long-form editing workflow. List every tool we use and what it costs per month.

5. **Documentation.** Write it so a non-technical person can run and fix the system. Every process gets a short written SOP plus a Loom video. We'll later package this as an AI setup for other Swiss small businesses, so it has to be clean and repeatable.



**You must have**

- Real, shipped work with **Claude**: Projects, connectors/MCP, Claude Code or the API. Show it, don't list it.

- Experience with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive), REST APIs and webhooks, and at least one of Make, Zapier or n8n.

- Clear written English. You write the prompts and the documentation.

- The habit of writing things down. If you can't document it, it doesn't count.

- At least 3 hours a day of overlap with Swiss business hours (CET/CEST).



**Nice to have**

- FareHarbor, Bexio, Windsor.ai, Meta Ads or WordPress experience.

- Video tools (OpusClip, CapCut, Descript or similar).

- Experience building multilingual AI assistants.

- Experience with data protection (GDPR or the Swiss nFADP).



**How we work**

- Remote, long-term, monthly contract. Starts with a paid trial period.

- All accounts belong to the company. You get access through our password manager. NDA required.

- You report daily: what you shipped, what broke, what you fixed and what's next.



**How to apply (follow exactly)**

1. **Video first (max 15 minutes, Loom or unlisted YouTube, one take, no edits). Put the link on the first line of your application.** Two parts:

   - **Part 1 (about 5 minutes): you and your work.** Share your screen and show one AI automation you built that runs for a real business. Then tell us why your setup would beat an owner who already uses Claude every day. Be specific: what would you do that he can't, or won't?

   - **Part 2 (10 minutes, live): build the first thing you'd build for us.** Start a timer and build it on screen, using any AI tool you like. Pick what you think matters most from the list above, e.g. Sarah answering a German group enquiry with a quote, or Sarah checking a rota against bookings. Talk while you work. In the last minute, say what you'd build next and how you'd document it.

   - If you need data you don't have, such as a price, don't invent it. Show how your system handles the gap.

   - Our public prices: axe throwing CHF 59 (1h), 69 (1.5h) or 79 (2h) per person; axe making (3h) CHF
per person depending on group size.

2. Below the video: your CV or portfolio, your monthly rate in USD and your available hours per day (Swiss time).

3. Put the word **"BULLSEYE"** in the first line of your message so we know you read this far.



No video = no review. Applications that skip any step are rejected automatically.



**Next step:** the best videos get a 30-minute video call with the owner.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: Marketing Operations Coordinator
description:
THE ROLE



Taylor Plumbing is a New Zealand plumbing and drainage contractor operating in six cities and growing into a national group. We are hiring one full-time, remote Marketing Operations Coordinator to run our marketing systems every day: Google Business Profiles, lead tracking reconciliation, landing page checks, review management and content collection from our field teams.



This is an operations job, not a creative job. You will run a written playbook, hit numbers, and report them. Strategy is set by the directors. If you want to design campaigns and tell us what the brand should be, this is not your role. If you want to own a checklist, execute it flawlessly and watch the numbers move because of you, read on.



Hours: Full-time, 40 hours, Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm New Zealand time (currently 3:00am to 11:30am Manila). Not negotiable; our customers and technicians work NZ hours.



Pay: NZ$1,800 to NZ$2,800 per month depending on experience, paid monthly via Wise, plus a 13th-month bonus after 12 months. Independent contractor agreement. Reviewed at 6 months.



Reports to: Director.



Start: As soon as the trial is passed.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Every day:



Reconcile yesterday’s numbers by 9:30am NZ: Google Ads conversions vs GoHighLevel leads vs Fergus jobs, by city and service. Post the three numbers and the gap in the daily report. If they do not match within 15%, find out why before anything else.

Reply to every new Google review in every city within 24 hours, in the business’s voice.

Send review requests to every completed job from the previous day via GoHighLevel, and chase non-responders once at day 3.

Check every landing page that took paid traffic yesterday: phone number correct for the city, form submits, tracking fires, page loads on a phone. Log the result.

Monitor Google Ads spend pacing against daily budgets and flag any campaign that has spent its budget before 2pm or spent nothing.



Every week:



Google Business Profile for each branch: one post, new photos from the field, Q&A answered, categories, hours and services verified.

Collect job photos, before-and-afters and CCTV clips from technicians via WhatsApp; file them by city and service; write the one-line caption.

Run the search-terms report for the main campaigns and list candidate negative keywords for director approval.

Check all directory listings (NoCowboys, Builderscrack, Yellow, Master Plumbers, Neighbourly) for correct details and new reviews.

Produce the weekly scorecard by Monday 10am NZ.



Every month:



Review count and rating per branch against target; plan to close the gap.

Audit every landing page for speed and correctness on mobile.

Update the playbook with anything that changed.

Execute approved change tickets in Google Ads and on landing pages exactly as written, and report back with before-and-after.



WHAT YOU ARE MEASURED ON



You will be judged on these numbers and nothing else. Reported weekly, by you, checked by the directors.



New Google reviews per branch per month: 20+

Review reply time: 100% within 24 hours

Daily reconciliation posted by 9:30am NZ: 100% of working days

Reconciliation gap (Ads vs GHL vs Fergus): under 15%

Landing-page faults found by you before a customer hits them: 100%

Field photos collected per week: 15+

GBP posts per branch per week: 1

Change tickets executed exactly as written, with before/after: 100%



Miss a target: tell us before we find it, with the reason and the fix. That is fine. Hide it: that is the end of the trial.



MUST-HAVES



2+ years in a marketing operations, digital marketing admin, or virtual assistant role for an Australian, New Zealand, UK or US business, with a reference from that business we can call.

Hands-on with Google Business Profile management for a multi-location business.

Hands-on with Google Ads reporting: you can read a campaign, keyword and search-terms report and explain what you see. You do not need to be a media buyer.

Comfortable in a CRM (GoHighLevel preferred; HubSpot, Zoho or similar acceptable) and in Google Sheets with formulas and lookups.

Written English clear enough to reply to a customer review on behalf of a New Zealand business without editing.

Reliable fibre internet, a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and a computer less than four years old.

Willing to use time-tracking software (Hubstaff or Time Doctor) for the first 90 days.

Full-time with us only. No other clients during our hours.



Nice to have: experience with a trades, home-services, franchise or multi-site business; Lovable, Webflow or WordPress page editing; Meta Business Suite and Microsoft Ads; basic Canva.



AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFIERS



A generic cover letter that does not follow the instructions below.

Not available 8:00am to 4:30pm NZ time, Monday to Friday.

Working for another client during those hours, or planning to.

No reference from an AU, NZ, UK or US business.

Describing yourself as a “growth hacker”, “brand strategist” or “SEO guru”. We are hiring an operator.

Any missed step in the application process. The job is following a process exactly; the application is the first test.



HOW TO APPLY



Follow every step. Applications that skip a step are not read.



Subject line must be exactly: MOC – [your first name] – [the number of Google reviews Taylor Plumbing Auckland currently has]. Find the number yourself.

No cover letter. Answer these four questions, numbered, each in three sentences or fewer:

a) One AU/NZ/UK/US business you worked for, your role, the dates, and the name and
 of someone there who will confirm it.

b) How many Google Business Profile locations you have managed at once, and the review count change while you managed them.

c) Your internet speed (paste a speedtest.net result link) and your backup connection.

d) Confirm in one sentence that you are available 8:00am to 4:30pm New Zealand time Monday to Friday with no other clients in those hours.

Attach a 60-second Loom screen recording of you opening any Google Ads search-terms report you have access to (or a demo account), pointing out one search term you would add as a negative and why. No slides, no script.



What happens next:



Step 1: We read applications that followed the instructions. Reply within 5 working days.

Step 2: Paid trial task, NZ$75, 2 hours. Read-only access to one branch’s Google Business Profile. You return a ranked list of the 10 things you would fix with the reason for each, plus three review-reply templates (5-star, 3-star, 1-star).

Step 3: 30-minute video call with the director. You walk through your trial task and reconcile a small set of numbers live.

Step 4: Two-week paid trial at full rate on the real job, with the playbook. At the end of week two you present your first weekly scorecard. Pass that and the role is yours.



We reply to everyone who reaches Step 2. We do not reply to applications that did not follow the instructions.
