title: Backend SEO & AEO Operations Manager for US Marketing Agency (Full-Time)
description:
About us

BoosterProfile is a US marketing agency. We help local home service companies (roofers, HVAC, contractors and more) get more calls from Google Maps, Google search and AI search like ChatGPT. We work with about 20 US business owners and add new ones every week.



The role

We run our fulfillment with an AI system (Claude) that does most of the hands-on work: Google Business Profile optimization, posts, keyword maps, rank tracking, WordPress sites and reports. We need one person who owns the backend and runs that system day to day, so the owner never has to think about it. You're the SEO brain behind it: local SEO, AI search (AEO), analytics, and Google Ads for the clients who run them.



What you'll do

- Get every new client set up: GBP manager access, website and DNS logins, GoHighLevel sub-account, tracking numbers

- Handle Google Business Profile verifications, suspensions and reinstatements

- Check how each client shows up in AI search (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini) and fix what's missing: schema, FAQs, citations, reviews, service and city pages

- Set up and read GA4 and Google Search Console for every client, and flag drops in traffic, calls or rankings

- Help manage Google Ads and Local Services Ads for the clients who run them

- Run A2P 10DLC registration for client texting (we give you the step-by-step)

- Check the AI's work before it goes live: GBP edits, site pages, posts, keyword lists

- Work through the daily task and approval list so nothing waits on the owner

- Watch our alerts. When something breaks, find out why and fix it or flag it fast.

- Keep the delivery tracker (Google Sheets) up to date



You're a fit if

- You've done local SEO or Google Business Profile work for US clients (agency experience is a big plus)

- You've handled GBP verification or suspension cases

- You understand AEO: how AI assistants pick which businesses to recommend, and what moves it (schema, citations, reviews, clear service pages)

- You've set up GA4 and Search Console and can explain what the numbers mean

- Bonus: Google Ads or Local Services Ads experience

- You're comfortable with WordPress, GoHighLevel and Google Sheets

- You already use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your work and like working with them

- You're careful. You check before you click publish.

- Your written English is clear



Hours

40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, with at least 4 hours overlapping US Pacific business hours.



How we hire

15-minute video call, then a 30-day paid trial, then full-time.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this are not read)

Start your application with the words "Backend Ready" and paste your Loom link (loom.com, free).



Your Loom must:

1. Be under 3 minutes, with your camera on at the start so we can see you

2. Say your name, where you're based, and the local SEO or GBP work you've done

3. Share your screen and show a Google Business Profile or website you've worked on, plus its GA4 or Search Console if you have it. Tell us what you changed and what moved.

4. Answer two questions out loud: a client's Google Business Profile just got suspended. What are the first 3 things you do? And how would you check whether ChatGPT recommends a business?

5. End by saying the words "Backend Ready"



No Loom, no review.

title: Sales Performance Manager | Long Term
description:
Primary responsibility

Improve the effectiveness of an existing sales team through KPI analysis, conversation audits, targeted coaching and measurable performance development.





About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, highly analytical Sales Performance Manager to lead and develop a team of online chat sales representatives.



This is not primarily an administrative or recruitment role.

Your responsibility is to make existing salespeople better at their jobs.



We have established systems, detailed performance dashboards, documented sales strategies and a team with varying levels of performance.



We need someone who can independently identify why certain salespeople significantly outperform others, investigate the causes and implement coaching that produces measurable improvements.





Your Responsibilities

- Analyze individual salesperson KPIs to identify performance gaps, weaknesses and trends.

- Study conversations from top-performing employees to understand what makes them successful.

- Review underperforming employees' conversations to identify specific behavioural problems.

- Develop individual coaching plans focused on the underlying causes of poor performance.

- Conduct one-on-one training, feedback sessions and performance reviews.

- Monitor whether employees are applying the corrections consistently.

- Measure KPI improvements and adjust coaching when interventions aren't working.

- Maintain clear accountability for performance across the team.

- Provide concise, evidence-based reports showing what problems were identified, what actions were taken and what improved.





What We're Looking For



Essential:

- Previous experience managing or coaching a sales team.

- Strong understanding of sales conversion, customer engagement and performance KPIs.

- Ability to analyze data and diagnose individual performance weaknesses.

- Experience reviewing sales conversations and providing actionable coaching.

- Strong communication skills and the confidence to address underperformance directly.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership and make evidence-based decisions.

- Excellent spoken and written English.





Highly Desirable:

- Experience managing online chat-based sales teams.

👉🏼

title: Travel Sales Specialist (WhatsApp / Chat Sales) – 25,000 THB Base + Uncapped Commission – Thailand Tour Group
description:
Who we are



We’re a tourism group on Koh Samui, Thailand, running since 2018. We started with one ATV tour company and grew it into four brands under one roof:



Jungle Quad: ATV tours through the island’s jungle

Jungle 4x4 Safari: private 4x4 island tours for couples, families and groups

Your Samui Booking Team: our concierge and booking agency. Boat trips, island tours, activities and experiences across Koh Samui, with partners we work with directly

Koh Samui Taxis: private transfers around the island



Our guests are international travellers, mostly from Europe, Australia and the UK, messaging us before and during their holiday. We don’t sell from a script or a call centre. We help people plan the best day of their trip, and we know the island better than anyone selling it online.



We’re building a proper sales department this season: our own sales platform, a product database the team can search instantly, and a Sales Manager who trains and supports you. You’d be one of the first people in it.



What you’ll do



Reply to incoming leads on WhatsApp, Instagram,
 and
, fast. Most guests book with whoever answers first and answers well.

Find out what each guest wants (who’s travelling, dates, ages, where they’re staying, what kind of day they’re after) and recommend the right tour or combination.

Build quotes and itineraries, close the booking, and take payment through our system.

Cross-sell across the brands: an ATV guest who’d love a private safari, a safari guest who needs a transfer.

Follow up on open quotes before they go cold.

Keep every lead and booking up to date in our CRM.

Coordinate with our team on the ground in Thailand so the guest’s day runs perfectly.



Who you are



Excellent written English. Warm, clear, never robotic. This is the most important thing.

At least [2] years in sales, ideally travel, hospitality or chat-based sales.

You enjoy closing. You’re motivated by commission, not scared of it.

Quick and organised. You can handle many conversations at once without dropping one.

Comfortable with WhatsApp Business, a CRM (we use Zoho) and Google tools.

Reliable internet, a backup connection and a quiet place to work.

Bonus: you’ve been to Thailand, or you’ve sold tours or experiences before.



What you get



A strong base salary of 25,000 THB / month.

Uncapped commission on every booking you close. In high season our sales team is currently earning around 20,000 THB / month in commission on top of base, and there’s no ceiling. (Our revenue grew 100% this year and expect the same growth next year) 

Full training on our tours, our sales platform and our process before you go live.

A product database and sales tools built for our team using AI, so you can answer any guest question in seconds.

Long-term role with room to grow as we add salespeople and brands.



How to apply



Send:



A short message (5–8 lines) on why you’d be good at this.

Your CV or a summary of your sales experience, with your best monthly results.

 marketing platforms

title: Remote Practice Manager – Australian Accounting Firm Experience Required
description:
We are looking for a Remote Practice Manager, who has worked in a fast-moving Australian accounting firm and understands the rhythm of compliance work, client follow-ups, workflow, deadlines and practice operations.



This role suits someone who enjoys keeping jobs moving, supporting accountants and admin staff, improving systems, and helping create a smooth and professional client experience.



About the Role



As the Remote Practice Manager, you will be the operational backbone of our accounting, taxation and finance business. You will oversee workflow, monitor job progress, follow up staff and clients, support the Director, and ensure our accountants and bookkeepers can focus on completing quality work.



You will help create a culture of accountability, client care, timely follow-up and continuous improvement.



This is not a basic VA role. 



We need someone who can take ownership, identify bottlenecks, escalate issues early and keep the practice moving without waiting for constant instructions.



Key Responsibilities



Manage day-to-day practice operations remotely

Oversee workflow management, job allocation and turnaround times

Monitor Zoho Desk tickets, job statuses and due dates

Follow up staff on outstanding tasks and overdue jobs

Follow up clients for missing documents, signing, approvals and payments

Monitor jobs waiting for bookkeeping, accountant review, final review and client response

Streamline systems and processes to improve efficiency and profitability

Support the Director with planning, reporting and operational execution

Help admin, accountants, bookkeepers and reviewers stay accountable

Oversee onboarding of new clients and help maintain a smooth client service journey

Ensure the team is using systems properly and keeping job notes updated

Monitor unpaid invoices and provide payment follow-up reports

Identify workflow bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements

Prepare daily or weekly practice reports for the Director

Support marketing follow-through, including Google reviews, lead lists and social media activity

Ensure ATO, BAS, tax return, ASIC and regulatory deadlines are monitored and followed up



What You Bring



Previous experience working with an Australian accounting firm is essential

Experience in practice management, workflow coordination, senior admin, client services or operations

Understanding of how Australian accounting and bookkeeping firms operate

Strong knowledge of tax return, BAS, bookkeeping, financial statement and client document workflow

Strong organisational and workflow management skills

Comfortable managing people, deadlines and competing priorities

Confident written communication with a client-first approach

Ability to follow up staff and clients professionally

Ability to analyse workflow, spot bottlenecks and suggest practical improvements

A calm, solutions-focused style with the ability to keep the practice moving forward

Ability to work independently and report clearly to the Director

Software Experience Preferred



Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:



Zoho Desk

Xero Practice Manager

Karbon

FYI Docs

MYOB AE / AO

Xero

QuickBooks

BGL / SMSF software

ATO Portal exposure

ASIC portal exposure

Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Teams

Google Sheets

ChatGPT / AI tools

CRM or workflow systems

Work Arrangement

Remote role

Part-time to start

Approximately 20 hours per week

Must be available during Australian business hours

Long-term opportunity for the right person

Opportunity to grow into a larger management role



Rate



AUD $9–$11 per hour, depending on experience.



Rate may be reviewed after 60–90 days based on reliability, ownership, communication, workflow control and ability to manage the role independently.



Important



Please do not apply if you have not worked with an Australian accounting firm before.



We are looking for someone who understands accounting practice workflow and can help manage jobs, people, clients, payments and deadlines with confidence.



This role is for someone who can take ownership of practice operations and help the Director run the business more efficiently.



To Apply



Please send:



Your resume

Details of your previous experience with Australian accounting firms

The systems and software you have used

The type of workflow you managed, such as tax returns, BAS, bookkeeping, financials, SMSF, ASIC or document chasing

Your expected hourly rate in AUD

Your availability during Australian business hours



Please also answer this question:



Tell us about your previous role with an Australian accounting firm and how you helped manage workflow, client follow-ups, document chasing, job deadlines, staff coordination and practice efficiency.

title: Head of Operations & Client Delivery
description:
Company: Effeect

Industry: Digital Marketing & Advertising

Position: Head of Operations & Client Delivery

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Reports To: Founder & CEO

Department: Operations & Client Services

Seniority: Head of Department / Senior Leadership



About Effeect

Effeect is a full-service digital marketing agency helping businesses grow through performance-driven marketing strategies.

We work with companies across multiple industries, delivering services including Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Paid Social, SEO, Social Media Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization,
 Marketing, Content Marketing, and Website Development.

Our approach combines strategy, creativity, data, and execution to deliver measurable business results.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operations & Client Delivery to take ownership of our daily agency operations, team coordination, project execution, and client delivery.

This is a senior leadership position for someone who knows how to run a digital marketing agency, manage teams, solve problems, and make sure work gets done correctly and on time.



The Role

The Head of Operations & Client Delivery will be responsible for ensuring that Effeect operates efficiently and consistently delivers high-quality services to its clients.

You will oversee the day-to-day operations of the agency, manage the execution of client projects, coordinate team members, monitor deadlines, and maintain high standards across every department.

You will serve as the main operational link between the CEO, internal teams, contractors, and clients.

Your primary responsibility is to make sure the agency runs smoothly without requiring the CEO's constant involvement in daily operations.

This is not an administrative assistant or traditional project coordinator position. We are looking for an experienced operational leader who can take ownership, make decisions, hold people accountable, and improve how the agency operates.



Key Responsibilities

1. Agency Operations Management

Take ownership of daily agency operations and ensure all departments operate efficiently.

Oversee internal workflows, project management systems, team coordination, and operational processes.

Develop, document, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical solutions.

Ensure company processes are followed consistently across departments.

Establish clear responsibilities, deadlines, priorities, and accountability for team members.

Monitor operational efficiency and continuously improve productivity.

Ensure that the agency can scale without sacrificing service quality.

Keep the CEO informed about important operational developments, risks, and decisions.

2. Client Delivery & Project Management

Take full ownership of client project delivery from onboarding to ongoing execution and offboarding.

Translate approved client agreements and service scopes into clear project plans, deliverables, tasks, and deadlines.

Ensure all client projects are properly organized in the agency's project management system.

Assign tasks to the appropriate specialists and monitor completion.

Track milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and project progress.

Identify delays, missing information, and delivery risks before they become major issues.

Ensure work is completed according to agreed scopes, timelines, and quality standards.

Review project status regularly and coordinate corrective actions where necessary.

Prevent scope creep by ensuring additional requests are identified, documented, and approved before execution.

Oversee client onboarding, ongoing service delivery, renewals, and offboarding procedures.

3. Team Leadership & Accountability

Manage daily coordination and operational performance across internal employees and contractors.

Work directly with specialists responsible for PPC, SEO, Paid Social, Content, Social Media, Design, Development, and other agency services.

Establish clear weekly priorities and individual deliverables.

Conduct regular team meetings, project reviews, and performance check-ins.

Ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.

Identify underperformance, recurring mistakes, and workflow problems.

Provide feedback, coaching, and performance improvement plans when necessary.

Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members.

Recommend staffing changes and additional resources based on workload and business needs.

Build a culture of ownership, accountability, reliability, and continuous improvement.

4. Client Communication & Satisfaction

Oversee the quality, consistency, and professionalism of client communication.

Ensure clients receive timely updates about project progress, completed deliverables, results, and next steps.

Serve as the senior escalation point for delivery-related client concerns.

Resolve operational issues and client complaints professionally and efficiently.

Coordinate between clients and internal specialists to prevent misunderstandings.

Ensure client requests are properly documented, prioritized, and assigned.

Participate in important client meetings when needed.

Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential retention risks.

Coordinate with the CEO on strategic accounts, significant commercial issues, and client relationship risks.

5. Quality Assurance & Delivery Standards

Establish and enforce quality assurance procedures across agency services.

Ensure deliverables meet internal standards and client requirements before submission.

Review the completeness, accuracy, and professionalism of client-facing work.

Coordinate technical or strategic reviews with qualified subject-matter specialists.

Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures.

Ensure reporting, deliverables, and project documentation are consistent and accurate.

Maintain quality standards as the number of clients and team members increases.

Take corrective action when work fails to meet expectations.

The Head of Operations is accountable for the quality assurance process. Technical specialists remain responsible for validating their professional work.

6. Resource Planning & Workload Management

Monitor team capacity, utilization, workloads, and delivery commitments.

Allocate resources according to project priorities, deadlines, and required expertise.

Identify overloaded or underutilized team members.

Forecast staffing requirements based on active projects and expected new business.

Coordinate freelancers and external contractors where necessary.

Prevent missed deadlines caused by poor planning or unclear ownership.

Work with the CEO to ensure client commitments are realistic and commercially sustainable.

7. Process Improvement, Automation & AI

Evaluate and improve the agency's operational systems and workflows.

Maintain and optimize the use of project management, communication, reporting, and documentation tools.

Identify repetitive activities suitable for automation.

Implement AI-assisted workflows where they improve efficiency without compromising accuracy, confidentiality, or client quality.

Reduce unnecessary meetings, manual follow-ups, duplicated tasks, and administrative work.

Develop repeatable workflows that allow the agency to onboard new clients and employees efficiently.

Ensure automations have clear ownership, appropriate access controls, and human review for important decisions.

Track the effectiveness of operational improvements.

8. Financial & Commercial Operations

Monitor project budgets, allocated hours, delivery costs, and account profitability.

Identify clients or projects that consistently require resources beyond their agreed scope.

Coordinate with the CEO on pricing, scope adjustments, and resource-related decisions.

Monitor operational costs and recommend efficiency improvements.

Support accurate tracking of billable and non-billable work.

Coordinate with finance or accounting personnel on invoice-related delivery information and client account status.

Provide operational input into proposals, project timelines, and new client commitments.

Financial approval, contract signing, and major commercial decisions remain with the CEO unless expressly delegated.

9. Reporting & CEO Communication

Provide weekly operational reports to the CEO.

Maintain clear visibility into all active clients, projects, deadlines, and team workloads.

Report upcoming delivery risks and unresolved operational issues.

Present recommendations rather than escalating routine issues without proposed solutions.

Maintain an accurate dashboard of operational and client delivery KPIs.

Escalate significant client, legal, financial, security, or reputational risks promptly.

Work closely with the CEO on growth planning and operational priorities.



Required Qualifications

5+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in digital marketing agency operations, client delivery, or project management.

At least 2 years of direct team leadership or operational management experience.

Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple client accounts and cross-functional marketing teams simultaneously.

Strong understanding of digital marketing services, including PPC, SEO, Paid Social, SMM,
 Marketing, and Web Development.

Proven ability to manage deadlines, delegate work, and hold team members accountable.

Experience developing and improving SOPs, workflows, and project management processes.

Strong knowledge of project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, Flowlu, or similar platforms.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong organizational, analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Experience handling client escalations and challenging delivery situations.

Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and make sound operational decisions.

Comfortable managing distributed teams across different time zones.

Proficiency with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, reporting dashboards, and modern collaboration tools.



Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience as Head of Operations, Operations Director, Delivery Director, Head of Client Services, or a similar senior agency role.

Experience scaling an agency's client delivery operations and team structure.

Experience managing both employees and international contractors.

Familiarity with agency profitability, resource utilization, capacity planning, and project-level financial performance.

Experience implementing automation and AI-enabled operational processes.

Familiarity with CRM systems, client portals, and agency reporting tools.

Experience working with performance marketing agencies and clients with substantial advertising budgets.

Experience supporting regulated industries such as financial services, fintech, forex, or cryptocurrency.

Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile project management qualifications.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed through the following measures. Initial targets will be confirmed after reviewing existing operations and establishing a baseline.

KPI

Initial Target

On-time client deliverables

95% or higher

Onboarding checklist completion

100%

Task ownership and deadline tracking

100% of active deliverables

Weekly client status reporting

100% of accounts requiring updates

Client delivery escalation response

Within 1 business day

Client satisfaction

90% or higher, measured consistently

Approved project scope adherence

95% or higher

Weekly CEO operations reporting

100%

SOP coverage

All critical operational processes

title: Outbound Cold Caller - Australian Mortgage Market
description:
OUTBOUND COLD CALLER – AUSTRALIAN MORTGAGE MARKET



JOB OVERVIEW



Home Loans by Choice is seeking a confident, proactive and phone-skilled Outbound Cold Caller to help generate qualified mortgage leads across the Australian market.



In this part-time role, you will be responsible for contacting Australian homeowners and prospective buyers, conducting online research to identify potential prospects, building targeted contact lists, qualifying prospective borrowers and booking appointments for our mortgage team.



This part-time position offers an hourly rate of AUD $6–$7, depending on experience, plus performance-based commissions for qualified leads that successfully progress through the loan process.



ABOUT HOME LOANS BY CHOICE



Home Loans by Choice is an Australian mortgage brokerage specialising in home loan solutions, refinancing and helping clients explore suitable lending options.



As the business continues to grow, we are looking for a motivated individual who can support our outbound lead generation efforts and help expand our client base across Australia.



SCHEDULE



• Monday to Friday

• 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM Australian time

• 20 hours per week

• Permanent work-from-home arrangement



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make outbound cold calls to Australian homeowners and prospective borrowers to introduce home loan and refinancing services.

• Research and source potential leads using property databases, Google Maps, online directories and other available platforms.

• Qualify prospects, assess their interest and identify potential refinancing opportunities.

• Book appointments for interested prospects with the mortgage team.

• Maintain accurate lead records, call outcomes and follow-ups using Google Sheets or the designated CRM.

• Provide regular updates on call activity, lead quality and appointment outcomes.



REQUIREMENTS



• Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation or appointment setting.

• Excellent spoken English and a confident, professional phone manner.

• Comfortable communicating with Australian homeowners and handling objections.

• Ability to research, organise and manage prospect lists independently.

• Familiarity with CRM systems, Google Sheets and VoIP calling platforms.

• Mortgage, home loan or Australian financial services experience is an advantage.





COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



• Hourly rate of AUD $6–$7, depending on experience.

• Additional performance-based commissions for qualified leads that successfully progress through the loan process.

• Permanent work-from-home arrangement.

• Consistent part-time schedule.

• Opportunity to work directly with an Australian mortgage brokerage.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your application directly through this job posting. Include your updated CV and a brief introduction outlining your relevant cold-calling, lead generation or appointment-setting experience.

 or through other channels will NOT be considered. Only applications submitted through OnlineJobs.ph will be reviewed.

title: Legal Executive Assistant
description:
NOW HIRING - Virtual Executive Assistant (Legal)

Position Details-

Location: 100% Remote (Philippines)

Hours: 40 hours per week

Employment Type: Full-Time, Long-Term

Firm Type: Active U.S. Law Firm (Criminal Defense, Juvenile Defense, CPS and Protective Orders)

Requirement: Prior experience with a U.S. law firm is mandatory!

About The Edgett Law Firm-

The Edgett Law Firm is a well-established, fast-paced criminal and juvenile defense firm based in McKinney, Texas. We primarily serve clients across Collin and Denton Counties and handle cases throughout the DFW Metroplex and the entire State of Texas. Our firm was founded by Scott Edgett, a licensed Texas attorney with 24 years of courtroom experience, and it operates with a White Glove client service standard. Behind every case is a client counting on us to stay on top of every date, deadline, and detail. That is where you come in. We are growing, and we need the right person to keep our operations organized and running smoothly behind the scenes.

Position Overview-

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-driven, and proactive Virtual Executive Assistant to directly support our Director of Operations. This is not a general administrative role. You will manage a high-volume inbox, coordinate schedules, communicate on the Director’s behalf, verify court dates, track case updates, and make sure every piece of client information is where it belongs. You must understand the sensitive and confidential nature of legal work and carry yourself accordingly in a professional environment.

What You Will Do-

• Manage a high-volume inbox, organizing messages by priority and sorting them into items that need a response and items that are for awareness only.

• Schedule calls and meetings as needed, and keep the calendar accurate and up to date.

• Draft and send
s on behalf of the Director of Operations in a professional, polished tone.

• Cross-check court dates from our tracking spreadsheet against the firm calendar, and flag any missing dates or conflicts.

• Prepare and organize case update requests to District Attorney’s Offices, and send them when directed.

• Assist with electronic filing of legal documents under attorney supervision.

• Track calls and enter notes into client files, keeping records accurate and current.

• Handle sensitive and confidential client information with the highest level of discretion.

What We Are Looking For-

• Prior experience as an executive assistant, legal assistant, paralegal, or similar role with a U.S. law firm is required. This is not negotiable.

• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail, especially with dates, names, and case information.

• Ability to manage a heavy workload and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience with case management systems preferred (MyCase or similar).

• Familiarity with court calendars, docketing, or e-filing is a strong plus.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and spreadsheets.

• Understanding of confidentiality and procedural compliance in a legal setting.

• Self-motivated, reliable, and proactive with minimal need for micromanagement.

Tools and Systems You May Work With-

• MyCase or similar legal case management platform

• Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets)

• Microsoft Office Suite

• Texas e-filing system

• GoTo or similar VOIP phone system

• Slack for internal team communication

• Zoom and Google Meet for virtual meetings

• AI-assisted tools to support workflow and communications

Work Schedule and Compensation-

This is a full-time remote position of 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, aligned to U.S. Central Time business hours. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not just fill a seat.

Compensation will be competitive and discussed based on your experience and qualifications. Long-term stability and growth opportunities are available for the right person.

Why Work With The Edgett Law Firm-

• You will work directly with our Director of Operations and an experienced legal team that values your role and treats you as a true member of the firm.

• This is a long-term opportunity with a firm that is actively growing across multiple locations.

• We have a team culture built on core values, accountability, and treating every client and team member with respect.

• You will gain deep experience inside a U.S. law firm environment that will elevate your professional career.

How to Apply-

To be considered for this position, please send the following:

1. An updated resume or profile with detailed experience and background.

2. A cover letter with a brief introduction explaining why you are the right person for this Executive Assistant position.

3. Any prior employer reviews, references, etc., if available.

4. Your desired compensation for this position.

**Please
 ALL of the above information to 
 with the subject line “Virtual EA – [Your Name]” for your consideration for this Executive Assistant position with The Edgett Law Firm.

Thank you for your interest in joining our legal team!

description:
Video Ad Editor: Direct Response
 Ads (Experienced Only)



Type of Work: Part-time  

Salary: $10 USD per final minute of edited video  

Hours: Flexible, but you must check in 4–5 days per week



JOB DESCRIPTION



We’re hiring an experienced video ad editor who already knows how to edit direct response ads for
 and Instagram.



This is NOT a training role. We need someone who understands how to create engaging video ads that sell, generate leads, and drive registrations.



We're also looking for someone who is comfortable using AI tools to speed up and improve their editing workflow. Experience with tools like Claude Code, Grok, and other AI-powered editing or video production tools is a major plus. If you've used AI tools to edit videos, generate creative assets, improve workflows, or enhance video ads, we'd love to see how you use them.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



- Short video ads (2 minutes or less) designed to sell event tickets, promote live events, or sell low-ticket online products.

- Ads that stop the scroll, keep people watching, and encourage viewers to click.

- Direct response creatives using talking-head footage, stage footage, testimonials, B-roll, captions, and other visual elements.



This is NOT for wedding, event recap, vlog, real estate, or cinematic videographers.



YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:



- Have edited real video ads that ran as paid advertisements, mainly on
 and Instagram.

- Know how to turn raw footage into compelling ads that drive conversions.

- Understand direct response marketing, hooks, pacing, storytelling, and audience retention.

- Can move fast, follow creative direction, and take feedback well.

- Are comfortable using AI tools to improve your editing process.

- Have experience with tools like Claude Code, Grok, or other AI-powered video editing and production tools.

- Are resourceful and know how to use technology to work smarter and deliver quality output.



AI experience is a strong advantage. We're particularly interested in editors who have already integrated AI into their creative workflow rather than relying entirely on traditional editing methods.



PAY



$10 USD per final minute of edited video.



You're paid based on the length of the finished ad, NOT the length of the raw footage.



For example:

- We send you 1 minute and 8 seconds of footage, and you edit it down to a 60-second ad = $10

- You deliver a 2-minute final ad = $20



HOW THE WORK RUNS



- We start with 2–3 simple projects. If those go well, the work becomes part-time but consistent.

- Tasks are assigned through Trello cards with all the details and instructions.

- You need to check in 4–5 days per week to see if new video work has been assigned.

- The workload varies. Some weeks are busy with multiple ads, while others are lighter.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply ONLY through this Google Form:







Please do not send your general portfolio.



Instead, provide a Google Drive folder containing the TOP 5 video ads you've ever edited that were specifically used to:

- Sell a product.

- Promote an event.

- Generate leads or registrations.



We also encourage you to include examples of how you've used AI tools in your video editing workflow, especially Claude Code, Grok, or similar tools.



Applications without 5 relevant video ad samples will NOT be reviewed.

title: QA Automation Engineer (Playwright) - Healthcare SaaS Startup
description:
ABOUT US

MedSpot is an AI-powered healthcare and medical platform. We are building a modern, HIPAA-aligned EMR and practice-management system connected to a growing network of physicians and clinics: patient records, scheduling, charting, billing, pharmacy ordering, telehealth and AI-assisted clinical workflows. We are a small, fast-moving US-led startup with a real product in the hands of early practitioners, and we want a quality-minded teammate who will grow with us.



THE ROLE

You will own quality for the platform. We need someone who can work close to fully autonomously: you find the problems, build the tests, report clearly, and suggest how we can ship better, without waiting to be told what to do. You will work directly with the founder and the engineering team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and maintain end-to-end test suites in Playwright (TypeScript) for our Next.js web app: practitioner signup, patient records, scheduling, billing/invoices, pharmacy ordering and AI features

- Test REST APIs and verify data accuracy (totals, statuses, labels, permissions)

- Run regression passes before each release and wire automated tests into CI

- Do exploratory testing and catch what scripted tests miss

- Write clear, reproducible bug reports (steps, expected vs actual, screenshots or video, console/network logs)

- Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to write tests and triage faster

- Proactively improve our QA process, tooling and release checklist



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years in QA automation; Playwright preferred (Cypress/Selenium with willingness to switch is fine)

- Solid JavaScript/TypeScript, Git, and API testing (Postman or similar)

- Excellent written English; able to work independently with minimal supervision

- Detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable owning outcomes



NICE TO HAVE

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions), basic SQL, healthcare/HIPAA or regulated-software experience, testing of AI/LLM features



IMPORTANT

You will work on a staging environment with synthetic data only. No real patient data. Basic HIPAA/security training will be provided.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short note on your QA automation experience, plus a link or description of a test suite you have built. Process: short screening call, then a paid take-home test (Playwright tests + a bug report).



SCHEDULE AND PAY

Full time, long-term role with room to grow. Some overlap with US Eastern morning hours preferred.

title: Accountant - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re not a lodgement factory. We work in our clients’ files every day, keep their books current, and give them advice they can actually act on. We’d rather have fewer clients we know well than hundreds we barely talk to.



We’re looking for an Accountant to take ownership of a portfolio of hospitality clients, lead compliance across all entity types, and be the person clients trust when they need a straight answer. You’ll work closely with the Director, review the work of our bookkeeping and accounting team, and help shape how we deliver advisory as the firm grows.



What you’ll do

▪ Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for individuals, companies, trusts and partnerships

▪ Review BAS/IAS and oversee payroll compliance, including STP, super and award-based wages

▪ Manage your own client portfolio – be their main point of contact and keep work moving to deadline

▪ Review and coach the work of bookkeepers and junior accountants, and help build our review processes

▪ Deliver practical advisory: cash flow forecasts, budgets, wage and cost-of-goods analysis, restructures and business purchases

▪ Deal with the ATO on clients’ behalf, including payment plans, objections and queries

▪ Help onboard new clients and scope engagements with the Director



What you’ll bring

▪ CA or CPA qualified (or well progressed towards it)

▪ 5 years’ experience in an Australian practice

▪ Solid working knowledge of tax and compliance across all entity types

▪ Strong Xero skills plus experience with XPM, Dext, Deputy and FoundU

▪ Confidence talking to business owners in plain English and managing your own workload

▪ Experience reviewing others’ work and giving useful feedback

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation, POS integrations, and a registered tax agent pathway



Answer these three questions to be considered:

1. What is your process on compiling EOFY Workpaper?

2. How many years of experience do you have in Australian taxation?

3. Do you also have experience in doing bookkeeping tasks?

title: REAL ESTATE WARM LEAD CALLER & APPOINTMENT SETTER
description:
# Job Posting: Warm Caller, Appointment Setter & CRM Manager (Real Estate — Preconstruction)



*TO APPLY SEND US A 1-2 MINUTE VOICE MESSAGE INTRODUCING YOURSELF*



## 🏠 About the Role

We're a Canadian real estate business specializing in **preconstruction townhomes and homes** across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), with a focus on Mississauga and Milton. We're looking for a sharp, motivated **Warm Caller / Appointment Setter / CRM Manager** to join our team and help connect qualified leads with real estate opportunities.



This is NOT a cold-call-into-the-void role — you'll be working warm/interested leads, booking appointments, and keeping our CRM organized and up to date. Full training provided — no real estate background required, but the traits below are non-negotiable.



## 💼 What You'll Be Doing

- Calling warm leads interested in preconstruction real estate in the GTA

- Booking qualified appointments that lead to closed deals

- Managing and updating our CRM — keeping lead statuses, notes, and follow-ups accurate and current

- Following up with leads through the pipeline (calls, texts, follow-up sequences)

- Working closely with our team to refine scripts and improve conversion



## 🕐 Schedule

- **8 hours/day, 6 days/week**

- Must be available to work **Eastern Time (Canada)** hours

- Full-time commitment — this is not a side gig



## 💰 Compensation

- **$1,000 CAD/month base salary**

- **+ $200 CAD per closed deal** that originates from an appointment you set

- Paid in **Canadian Dollars (CAD)**

- Uncapped upside — the more qualified appointments you set that convert, the more you earn on top of your base



## ✅ Requirements

- **Prior experience in cold/warm calling** — sales, appointment setting, or a similar outbound phone role

- **Master-level spoken English** — clear, confident, and easily understood by Canadian callers. This is one of the most important requirements for this role, since you'll be speaking directly with clients across the GTA.

- Comfortable and reliable working **Eastern Time hours**, 6 days a week

- Strong organizational skills — you'll be responsible for keeping the CRM clean and accurate, not just making calls

- Reliable internet connection, quiet call environment, and professional phone manner



## 🔥 Who We're Looking For

- **Hungry** — genuinely motivated to grow and earn more through performance

- **Disciplined** — shows up consistently, doesn't need to be micromanaged

- **Organized** — can manage a pipeline of leads without things falling through the cracks

- **Coachable** — willing to learn real estate/preconstruction knowledge from scratch through our training program



## 📩 HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

Applications without this will not be considered.



**Send a 1–2 minute voice message introducing yourself.** Tell us:

- Your name and where you're calling from

- Your relevant calling/sales experience

- Why you think you'd be a great fit for this role



We're listening for clarity, confidence, and energy — not a script. Just talk to us like you'd talk to a client.



---

*This is a long-term opportunity for the right person — we're building a team, not just filling a seat.*

title: Senior AI Ad Creative Specialist (AI Video, Higgsfield, Static Ads) - E-commerce
description:
PLEASE READ: This is a SENIOR role. We are looking for an experienced AI creative who already makes high-performing ads with AI tools. This is not a beginner or entry-level position.



ABOUT US

We are a fast-growing e-commerce company selling everyday comfort products (apparel and home) to customers in the Nordic countries. We spend daily on
/Instagram ads and test new creatives every day. Next year we are launching a new brand for Europe and the US, and we want you to be the creative engine behind it.



THE ROLE

You will make 3-5 new ad creatives per day, mostly with AI, and bring your own ideas for angles and hooks. AI is at the center of how we work: you will use AI tools every day to create videos, images and variations faster and better than traditional editing. This is a long-term role where you can grow into leading our creative production.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Create AI video ads with tools like Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Veo, Hailuo or similar (product shots, UGC-style scenes, motion effects, talking avatars)

- Create AI images and product scenes (Midjourney, Flux, ChatGPT images, Nano Banana or similar) and turn them into scroll-stopping static ads

- Edit and finish video ads (CapCut/Premiere): 15-30 sec, strong hook in the first 2 seconds, captions, fast pacing

- Make static ads (Canva/Photoshop) with offers, prices and badges in 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16

- Make many variations of our winning ads: new hooks, new first frames, new AI scenes

- Suggest your own angles and hooks based on what is winning

- Write and refine your own prompts, and keep up with new AI tools as they come out

- Translate short ad texts into Norwegian, Finnish and Danish with AI (we review before launch)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- 15+ finished creatives per week, delivered on time

- 2-3 new winning ads per week (we track results together)

- You constantly test new AI workflows that make our ads better and faster



REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE)

- 2+ years making paid social ads 
/Instagram/TikTok) for e-commerce

- Strong, proven skills with AI video tools - Higgsfield experience is a big plus

- Strong skills with AI image tools and prompting

- Portfolio with real AI-made ads (video and static) - required

- You understand direct-response ads: hooks, angles, UGC style, offers

- Works independently, fast and reliable, and can take a short brief and run with it

- Good written English

- Available for a short daily check-in during our morning (CET)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager and reading ad results (CTR, ROAS)

- Experience with clothing, underwear or home products



HOW WE WORK

Every morning you get a short brief with what is winning and what to make. You deliver the creatives and texts, we review and launch them. Once a week we have a short call about results and new ideas.



HOW TO APPLY

- Send links to AI-made ads you have created (Google Drive or similar) - applications without a portfolio will not be considered

- List the AI tools you use every day and what you use each one for

- Write "CREATIVE7" at the top of your application so we know you read the whole post



Shortlisted applicants will get a small paid test task using AI tools.

title: Google Maps & Business Research VA — Part-Time, No Calling
description:
We’re looking for a detail-oriented virtual assistant to research US businesses and build accurate prospect lists for an outdoor sign salesperson.



We sell electronic message centers: digital roadside signs that businesses use to display specials and promotions. Your job is to find businesses that currently have manual changeable-letter signs—the kind where someone physically replaces individual letters.



This is a research-only role. You will not make calls, send sales messages, or set appointments.



THE WORK



- Research businesses in assigned Minnesota cities, starting with Lakeville.

- Use Google Maps, Street View, business websites, and other public sources to identify businesses with manual changeable-letter signs.

- Save a source link and screenshot showing the sign, and record the image date when available.

- Verify the business name, address, website, phone number, and whether it is still operating.

- Research the owner, operating company, or relevant decision-maker and publicly listed business contact details.

- For franchise locations, research the local franchise owner rather than assuming the national brand owns the location.

- Enter your findings into a shared Google Sheet, with source links and clear notes.

- Check for duplicates and flag missing or uncertain information.



Examples of relevant businesses include restaurants, hardware stores, grocery stores, and other businesses that advertise changing specials to passing traffic.



For this initial project, exclude businesses whose only signs are already digital, fixed business-name signs, and permanently closed businesses. We will provide examples and detailed instructions.



ACCURACY EXPECTATIONS



- Every proposed lead needs visual evidence of a qualifying sign.

- Older photos must be flagged; an old Street View image does not prove the sign is still there today.

- Never guess owner names,
 addresses, or other details. Mark information as “Not found” when you cannot verify it.

- A strong prospect can still qualify even if you cannot find the owner’s
 address.

- Put unclear signs or conflicting information in a separate “Needs verification” section.

- Quality matters more than filling the spreadsheet with names.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- Experience with online research, lead research, or business data collection.

- Comfortable using Google Maps, Street View, and Google Sheets.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written instructions.

- Good written English.

- Reliable communication and follow-through.

- Willingness to ask questions and report uncertainty honestly.



Prior experience researching US businesses or franchise ownership is helpful. Sign industry experience is not required.



HOURS AND PAY



- $6–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated work quality.

- Approximately 5–10 hours per week initially.

- Flexible working hours; US overnight shifts are not required.

- Potential for ongoing work and additional hours as our prospecting program grows.

- Please acknowledge messages within one working day and send a brief progress update after each work session.



PAID TEST AND TRIAL



Shortlisted applicants will receive the same paid research test: find up to five matching businesses in Lakeville, Minnesota, using our instructions and spreadsheet format.



The test will have a two-hour limit and will be paid at an agreed hourly rate. If you find fewer than five legitimate matches within that time, submit what you found and explain your search. Do not add weak leads just to reach five.



We will evaluate accuracy, source evidence, spreadsheet organization, communication, and how well you follow instructions.



The selected candidate will then begin a one-week paid trial before we agree on ongoing work.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



- A brief description of your relevant research experience.

- Your experience using Google Maps and Street View.

- A sample of a research spreadsheet you created, with confidential information removed. If you cannot share one, describe the work instead.

- Your requested hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

- A short answer to this question: If Street View shows a manual letter sign in a photo from several years ago, how would you check whether the business still has that sign?



Please begin your application with “Sign Research” so we know you read the full description.



You do not need to research any new leads before being selected for the paid test.

description:

We've recently launched our new website and refreshed our branding, and we're now looking to take our

Whilst we've run Meta Ads previously, they've never received the attention or strategy they deserve. We're looking to change that by bringing in an experienced Meta Ads Specialist who can take ownership of the channel and help us turn it into a consistent, profitable source of enquiries and customers.



The Role



We're looking for someone who can manage our Meta advertising from start to finish.



We don't just want someone who can set up campaigns and switch ads on. We want someone who takes the time to understand our business, our customers, our products and what makes us different.



You'll work closely with our Marketing Manager to develop a paid social strategy that reaches the right audiences, generates quality enquiries and, most importantly, delivers a strong return on investment.



You'll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, test different approaches and recommend what you believe will work best.



What You'll Be Responsible For:



- Strategy & Planning: Developing a Meta Ads strategy aligned with our business objectives, products and target audiences.

- Campaign Management: Setting up, managing and optimising
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Audience Targeting: Researching and identifying relevant audiences, including prospecting, retargeting and lookalike opportunities where appropriate.

- Ad Copywriting: Creating engaging, persuasive ad copy that speaks to our customers and encourages them to take action.

- Creative Development: Designing and producing ad creatives, including static images, carousels and video content where appropriate.

- Testing & Optimisation: Continuously testing audiences, messaging, creatives and campaign structures to improve performance.

- Tracking & Reporting: Ensuring conversion tracking is set up correctly and providing clear, actionable performance reports.

- Lead Generation: Focusing on generating quality insurance enquiries that have the potential to convert into customers.

- Collaboration: Working with us to understand our products, customer behaviour, sales process and unique selling points.



What We're Looking For:



- Proven experience managing successful Meta Ads campaigns, ideally for UK businesses.

- Strong understanding of
 and Instagram advertising, including campaign structure, targeting, optimisation and Meta Pixel/Conversions API.

- Experience running lead generation campaigns, rather than purely e-commerce or brand awareness campaigns.

- Excellent copywriting skills, with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences.

- Ability to create high-quality, engaging ad creatives.

- A commercial mindset, with a genuine focus on ROI, cost per lead and customer acquisition.

- Confidence interpreting campaign data and making recommendations based on performance.

- Someone proactive, creative and comfortable suggesting new ideas.

- Strong communication skills and a willingness to understand our business rather than applying the same strategy to every client.



Experience in insurance, financial services or other competitive lead generation industries would be an advantage, but isn't essential.



We want to build Meta Ads into a reliable marketing channel for Catering Insurance. For us, success isn't just about clicks, impressions or cheap leads. It's about attracting the right people, generating genuine enquiries and ultimately increasing the number of policies we sell.



We're looking for someone who understands this and is motivated by delivering measurable results.



What We Can Offer



- A newly launched website and refreshed branding to work with.

- A collaborative relationship with our Marketing Manager.

- The opportunity to take ownership of our Meta advertising strategy.

- Room to experiment, test new ideas and develop campaigns as we grow.

- Flexible remote working arrangements.



## How to Apply



If this sounds like something you'd be interested in, we'd love to hear from you.



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and an overview of your Meta Ads experience.

2. Examples of campaigns you've managed, ideally focused on lead generation.

3. Details of the results you've achieved, including cost per lead, lead quality or ROI where possible.

4. Examples of ad creatives and copy you've produced yourself.

5. Your availability and expected hourly or monthly rate.



Please note:We're specifically looking for someone with hands-on Meta Ads expertise who can manage both the strategic and creative sides of our campaigns. This isn't a general social media management position.



We're looking for someone who can become a valued part of our marketing efforts and help us build something successful over the long term.

description:
WHAT THIS IS

We're an Australian jewelry brand. We make personalized 18K gold plated jewelry — names, birthstones, initials — and we've served over 500,000 customers since 2022.

Almost all our growth comes from video ads on
 and Instagram, and we ship around 100 new creatives a week. We have more good footage and more good briefs than we have hands to cut them. That's the job.

This is a long-term, ongoing role. We are not looking for a project freelancer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Cut finished 9:16 vertical ads from written briefs and raw creator footage, plus 4:5 and 1:1 versions

- Re-cut the opening 3 seconds of winning ads into 2–3 alternate hooks — a big part of the role

- Burned-in captions, properly timed — not raw auto-transcription

- Text overlays, price cards and call-to-action end frames

- Audio cleanup: levels, noise, ducking

- Colour matching across creators shot in different lighting

- Naming and delivering files to our convention

- 20–30 finished variants a week once you're up to speed



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years on short-form vertical, including at least 1 year on direct-response ADS (Meta, TikTok, Shorts). Wedding films and long-form YouTube alone won't be enough here.

- Experienced in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut

- Fast and comfortable in CapCut. Most of our volume is quick variants, and that's where speed matters.

- Excellent written and spoken English

- A machine that handles a multi-layer 4K timeline: M1 Mac or better with 16GB+, or Windows with 16GB+ and a dedicated GPU. Plus 50 Mbps+ internet with a backup connection. Please don't apply if your setup is below this — it makes the turnaround times impossible and neither of us will enjoy it.



HOURS AND PAY

- 25–30 hrs/week, Monday to Friday. You pick your window as long as it overlaps at least 3 hours with Australian business hours — 9am to 2pm Philippine time works well.

- Rate is negotiable and based on experience — tell us your hourly rate in USD and we'll work from there. Paid twice monthly by Wise.

- Option to go full-time.



THE TRIAL EDIT

We're not going to hire off a résumé. We want to see you cut one ad.

Everything you need is in this folder:







Inside you'll find the creator clips and the b-rolls. That's all we're giving you — forthe brand and who we sell to, go to 
 and have a look around.

We have deliberately NOT included examples of our existing ads. We want to see how you'd approach this, not how well you can copy us.

MAKE US ONE AD:

- 9:16 vertical, exported as MP4

- Keep the jewelry clear and central

- Add background music

- There's no script and that's deliberate. The clips are all there — how you arrange them into an ad is the part we want to see. Order, structure, length, pacing, hook, on-screen text: all yours.

- Budget about 2 hours. We've pulled out the usable clips for you so you're not wading through a full footage dump. We know it's still real time and we don't ask for it lightly — but this is a long-term position and we want to get it right, so we'd rather see one ad you actually cut than read twenty résumés.



HOW TO APPLY

Four things. OnlineJobs.ph can't take file attachments, so everything below needs to be a link — Google Drive, Dropbox or an unlisted YouTube video. Paste them into your application message.

- Your trial edit — a Google Drive or unlisted YouTube link. Please check the sharing is set so we can actually open it.

- Your résumé and a link to your portfolio or reel.

- Your available hours per week and the daily window you'd work, in Philippine time.

- Your hourly rate in USD. Give a number — “negotiable” tells us nothing.

We really appreciate the time everyone puts into this. We'll do our best to get back to everyone who submits an edit.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing end-to-end medical billing processes, navigating insurance claims, following up on unpaid balances, and resolving complex billing inquiries.



Because this position requires frequent verbal and written communication with US-based insurance providers, healthcare practitioners, and patients, exceptional, fluent English communication skills (both spoken and written) are strictly required.

Key Responsibilities



Claim Submission & Management: Accurately prepare, code, and submit primary and secondary medical claims to insurance companies (Medicare, Medicaid, and private commercial carriers).



Accounts Receivable & Follow-Up: Monitor claim status, conduct regular accounts receivable (A/R) follow-ups, and investigate unpaid, delayed, or rejected claims.



Denials & Appeals: Identify reasons for claim denials, perform root-cause analysis, gather necessary documentation, and draft/submit persuasive formal appeals.



Payer & Patient Communication: Contact US insurance representatives via telephone or online portals to clarify coverage details, resolve claim disputes, and clarify authorization issues.



Payment Posting & Reconciliation: Post insurance and patient payments, apply adjustments, and reconcile patient accounts accurately within the billing software.



Patient Inquiries: Handle professional, empathetic, and clear communication with patients regarding billing statements, outstanding balances, and payment arrangements.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 

- Minimum of 1+ years of direct experience in US medical billing, A/R follow-up, or medical claims processing.

- English Proficiency: Exceptional verbal and written English skills (C1/C2 or fluent level). Must be confident making phone calls to US insurance companies and drafting clear, professional written appeals.



Technical Knowledge:

- Solid understanding of US healthcare insurance concepts (Deductibles, Co-pays, Co-insurance, EOBs, ERA, Out-of-Network benefits).

- Familiarity with standard medical coding systems (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS) and billing guidelines.

- Experience working with EHR/EMR and Billing software (e.g., Kareo, Practice Fusion, AdvancedMD, ECW, or similar).

 

Skills: 

- Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, high accuracy in data entry, and ability to manage workload during US Central Time business hours.



Technical / Equipment Requirements

- High-speed, reliable internet connection (25+ Mbps minimum) with a backup internet solution.

- Quiet, private, home-office environment compliant with HIPAA privacy guidelines.

- Modern computer setup (Core i5 / Ryzen 5 or higher, 8GB+ RAM) with a clear, noise-canceling headset for phone calls.



What We Offer

 - Competitive hourly pay ($4.00 – $6.00/hr based on experience).

 - Full-time hours with a stable long-term team.

 - Supportive management and opportunities for skill expansion.



How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit the following:

1. An updated Resume/CV highlighting your relevant US medical billing experience.

2. A Short Voice Recording / Video Intro (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and summarizing your background in medical billing (required to verify spoken English fluency and phone clarity).

3. Confirmation of your ability to work Texas (CST) hours.

Please send your application to

title: Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager – Beauty Brand (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
This is a long-term, full-time, work-from-home role with an ambitious, fast-growing Australian beauty brand.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager to own and accelerate the brand’s direct-to-consumer growth. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who can turn customer insight, creative ideas and performance data into stronger conversion, more efficient acquisition and sustained sales growth.



Focus: Ecommerce growth | Platform: Shopify | Channels: Paid, CRM and web



ABOUT THE BRAND



We are an age-positive Australian beauty brand creating high-performing, uncomplicated products for women who want beauty to feel relevant, joyful and real. We are building a distinctive brand with ambitious growth plans across Australia and international markets.



THE ROLE



You will lead the ecommerce growth engine across Shopify, paid media, CRM and onsite conversion. You will work closely with the social and creative teams to turn brand stories, customer problems and cultural moments into high-performing ads, hooks, landing pages and campaigns. You will be equally comfortable setting the strategy, briefing creative, managing activity in platform and digging into the numbers to d
 what happens next.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Ecommerce and Shopify ownership:

- Own the day-to-day performance and commercial growth of the brand’s Shopify store.

- Manage site merchandising, product launches, collections, promotions and campaign updates, ensuring the customer journey is seamless from landing page to checkout.

- Build and maintain a conversion optimisation roadmap across product pages, landing pages, bundles, offers, navigation, mobile experience and checkout.

- Use customer behaviour, site analytics and testing to identify friction, prioritise improvements and increase conversion rate and average order value.

- Coordinate developers and agency partners, writing clear briefs and ensuring work is delivered accurately and on time.



Paid media and profitable growth:

- Own paid performance strategy and execution across Meta and Google, including campaign structure, budgets, optimisation, testing and in-platform management.

- Set clear growth targets and manage spend against revenue, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, contribution margin and new-customer growth.

- Build a disciplined testing program across audiences, offers, formats, landing pages, hooks and creative concepts.

- Scale winning campaigns while protecting efficiency, and act quickly when performance changes.

- Translate channel data into clear actions and commercial recommendations for the leadership and wider team.



Creative strategy and campaign development:

- Work closely with social, brand and creative teams to build the advertising strategy, creative pipeline and campaign calendar.

- Develop sharp customer-led hooks, briefs and testing angles that connect the brand’s brand voice with clear product benefits and reasons to buy.

- Analyse creative performance to identify which messages, formats, talent and concepts drive sales, then feed those learnings back into content production.

- Write and refine on-brand copy for ads,
, landing pages and web campaigns.

- Ensure campaigns land consistently across paid ads, organic social,
, website and retail touchpoints.



CRM and customer growth:

- Own
 and CRM in Klaviyo, including campaign planning, automations, segmentation, testing, creative and reporting.

- Grow customer lifetime value through effective welcome, education, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and loyalty journeys.

- Use customer data and insights to improve retention, repeat purchase and the relevance of the brand’s communication.



Reporting, SEO and optimisation:

- Create a clear weekly trading and performance view covering revenue, traffic, conversion, average order value, channel efficiency, customer acquisition and retention.

- Own the digital trading rhythm, identifying risks and opportunities early and recommending the actions required to hit sales targets.

- Support SEO and content strategy, including the brand’s menopause and perimenopause education hub, working with agency partners and developers.

- Build a culture of testing and learning, with documented hypotheses, results and next steps.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Consistent, profitable growth in online revenue and new-customer acquisition.

- Improved Shopify conversion rate, average order value and customer lifetime value.

- A reliable creative testing engine with a steady pipeline of new hooks and winning ad concepts.

- Stronger paid media efficiency and confident scaling of spend.

- Clear, actionable reporting that helps the team make faster commercial decisions.

- Well-executed launches and campaigns delivered seamlessly across all digital touchpoints.



ABOUT YOU



- Fluent English, spoken and written (essential)

- Senior ecommerce or growth marketing experience in a high-growth beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness or consumer brand, with a strong record of increasing online sales.

- Deep, hands-on Shopify experience and a strong understanding of ecommerce merchandising, customer journeys and conversion optimisation.

- Highly experienced in paid social and paid search, particularly Meta and Google, with the ability to manage campaigns directly rather than relying entirely on agencies.

- Experience applying proven ecommerce growth frameworks, with strong testing discipline and growth methodology.

- Strong Klaviyo and CRM experience across campaigns, automations, segmentation and retention strategy.

- A proven ability to use data to make decisions, prioritise activity and explain performance clearly to non-specialists.

- Strong creative judgement and experience partnering with social and creative teams to develop performance-led concepts, hooks and briefs.

- Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with a sharp understanding of brand tone and customer motivation.

- Commercially minded, highly organised and comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Proactive, accountable and calm under pressure, with the confidence to challenge, recommend and act.



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Experience growing a beauty brand across Australia and the United States.

- Experience with subscription, bundles, gifting, loyalty or referral programs.

- Working knowledge of GA4, attribution tools, dashboards, SEO and Shopify analytics.

- Experience managing agency, freelance and developer relationships.



HOW WE WORK



This role suits someone who loves pace, ownership and visible commercial impact. You will be expected to bring ideas, test them quickly, learn from the results and work generously across brand, creative, social and operations. Here, strong performance and strong brand building should reinforce each other.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your CV and a short note outlining the ecommerce growth you have personally driven. Include examples of Shopify conversion improvements, paid media results, creative testing programs and the ecommerce growth frameworks you have used.

title: Australian Healthcare Bookkeeper (Xero) | Axis Imaging
description:
Remote from the Philippines · Working with our Melbourne team



Axis Imaging is a diagnostic imaging business based in Mickleham, Victoria. Our clinic provides CT, ultrasound, X-ray and bone density scans. As we prepare to open more sites, we’re looking for a bookkeeper to own our day-to-day accounts in Xero and work directly with the owners and our Australian accountant.



Each week, the owners need to know how much cash is available, what’s due before the next pay run, and which items need their attention. You’ll keep the books current, investigate differences and give us a short, clear update we can act on.



What you’ll own



• Bank reconciliations. Reconcile bank and credit card transactions in Xero each week. Match clinic receipts against billing reports and follow up on differences.

• Bills and payments. Manage the accounts inbox, match invoices to supporting records, check for duplicates and prepare payment batches for approval.

• Payroll support. Check fortnightly timesheets against payroll inputs, flag discrepancies before the pay run and reconcile payroll accounts afterward.

• Weekly cash reporting. Summarise cash balances, upcoming payroll and supplier payments, overdue receipts and any decisions the owners need to make.

• Month-end close. Reconcile balance sheet accounts, maintain prepayment and accrual schedules, and prepare a monthly P&L with brief explanations for material changes. Work with our accountant on BAS preparation and queries.



What we’re looking for



You’ve managed bookkeeping for an Australian business in Xero and can take a set of books through month-end independently. You’re comfortable with GST coding, payroll reconciliations and Excel or Google Sheets. You communicate clearly, handle financial and payroll information confidentially, and follow up when you’re missing an invoice or approval. Experience in a medical, dental or allied health practice is a plus.



How to apply



Send your CV and a short note about an Australian business whose books you managed. Tell us which parts of the weekly and monthly bookkeeping you handled yourself.



Include one example of a reconciliation that didn’t balance. What was the discrepancy, how did you investigate it, and how did you resolve it? Please leave out client names and confidential details.



Let us know your availability, the hours you can overlap with Melbourne, and your expected monthly pay in PHP for those hours.

title: Communications Manager
description:
Mop & Pop is a Dubai-based cleaning company working with holiday rental properties. We’re looking for an experienced Communications & Operations VA to manage day-to-day communication with property owners and their teams, and help keep our cleaning schedule running smoothly. 



This is a fast-paced role where timings change, guests check out late, and competing priorities need quick decisions. We need someone who takes ownership, checks the facts and speaks up when something doesn’t add up.



What you’ll do



Manage daily communication with property owners, property managers and their assistants.

Confirm checkout times, upcoming check-ins and access arrangements so our team can plan accurately.

Keep clients informed about cleaning progress, delays and any issues affecting a property’s readiness.

Respond quickly when guests haven’t checked out, access is unavailable, or plans change.

Make sure the relevant person contacts the guest when needed, and follow through until the issue is resolved.

Work closely with our cleaning team to understand availability, workloads and realistic completion times.

Learn each client’s properties, requirements and communication preferences.

Use cleaner performance rankings and property cleaning-time data to support practical decisions.

Spot potential scheduling problems early and suggest solutions before they affect the next job.

Keep clear, accurate records so everyone is working from the same information.



What we’re looking for



Previous experience in a similar communications or operations role within holiday rentals, property management, cleaning or hospitality.

Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally and firmly when needed.

Strong judgement and the confidence to question incorrect or incomplete information.

The ability to prioritise, think ahead and make practical decisions under pressure.

Close attention to detail, particularly around timings, property instructions and follow-ups.

Confidence working with data, schedules and performance information.

A reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working setup.

Availability for the full working hours, six days per week.



How you’ll succeed



You’ll need to understand how one delayed checkout can affect several cleans and incoming guests. Simply acknowledging a message isn’t enough: you’ll check what it means for the schedule, identify who needs to act and make sure the next step happens.



We value people who ask useful questions, flag concerns and recommend a better approach. If a checkout time looks wrong or a deadline is unrealistic, we expect you to raise it.



To apply



Please send your CV and a short explanation of your relevant experience, including the number of properties or daily jobs you’ve supported.



Working hours will be 8 am - 4 pm Dubai time zone.
