  worked with matters as much as the videos themselves.

- Tell us what you edit in (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, Final Cut).

- Good written English - you'll be reading briefs from us and asking questions.

- A machine and internet connection that can actually handle video files.

- Someone who asks when they're unsure instead of guessing. We'd much rather

  answer a question than fix a mistake.



EXTRA HOURS IF YOU WANT THEM (optional, not required)

If you also want more hours, there's social work available on top of the editing -

replying to comments and DMs, posting Stories, and replying to people who comment

"too expensive" or "where do I buy this" with the current offer. We give you the

exact lines to use. Say in your reply if you're interested. It won't count against

you if you'd rather only edit.



If you can also do light Shopify/website work - small landing page or upsell

changes, using an AI assistant like Claude or ChatGPT to write the code - mention

it. It's a bonus that affects pay, not a requirement.



WHAT WE DON'T NEED

- A team or an agency. We're hiring one person directly.

- Someone who films. You're editing footage we send you.



HOURS AND PAY

Around 15-20 hours a week to start, long-term, with more hours available as we

grow. Paid weekly.

$5-7 USD/hour depending on your experience and your portfolio, reviewed after the

first month. If you'd rather be paid per video, tell us your price per finished

edit and we'll consider it.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word CANVAS so we know you read this.



Then send us:

1. Your Google Drive link, set to "anyone with the link can view"

2. The brands you've edited for, and which of them sell clothing

3. What you edit in

4. What hours you can work (your local time is fine)

 and Instagram advertisements for

**Examples of the content we're looking for:**

Start your application with the word kumustra so we know you've read the entire posting. We provide the products, advertising budgets, and infrastructure. **You focus on creating winning ads.**

- Your bonuses increase as your winning ads scale to $10,000, $50,000, $100,000, and beyond.

- High-performing creators can qualify for base salary increases of up to 100%.

Bonuses are subject to performance requirements and the company's compensation SOP.

You must:



- Have hands-on experience creating AI-generated video advertisements.

- Understand
 and Instagram direct-response advertising.

- Know how to research winning hooks, angles, and creative formats.

- Be proficient with AI video generation and editing tools.

- Have an established production workflow and be comfortable producing at volume.

- Be resourceful, independent, organized, and results-oriented.

- Be comfortable using your own AI tools and generation credits initially.

The final office city, work arrangement and start date will be confirmed before an offer; any initial remote training arrangement must be agreed in advance.

WHO THIS SUITS

- At least 2 years of relevant experience in BPO, administrative operations, HR coordination, a service business or back-office support.

- Some real experience coordinating people, training colleagues or owning a workflow. Team leaders and senior coordinators ready to take more responsibility are welcome.

- Clear spoken and written English, good spreadsheet skills and accurate documentation.

- Dependable attendance, honest reporting, organized follow-through and comfort asking questions early.

- Willingness to learn, accept corrections and show improvement. Prior spa or Zenoti experience is helpful but not required.

title: Senior Accountant / Finance Executive (Remote)
description:
Company: Pawkit Pte Ltd (Singapore)

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time



About Pawkit

Pawkit is a Singapore-based pet technology company providing convenient, high-quality veterinary and pet care services at customers' homes.

We are looking for an experienced accountant to independently manage our day-to-day accounting operations, ensure financial accuracy and maintain organised financial records.



Key Responsibilities



1. Daily Accounting & Reconciliation

- Create, verify and manage customer invoices in Xero.

- Reconcile bank transactions, Stripe payments, refunds and Wise transactions.

- Verify payments against customer bookings, services rendered and invoices.

- Identify and resolve duplicate invoices, missing payments, outstanding balances and payment discrepancies.

- Follow up on outstanding invoices and maintain accurate accounts receivable records.



2. Accounts Payable & Provider Payouts

- Process supplier invoices, expenses and accounts payable.

- Prepare and verify service provider payouts twice monthly.

- Reconcile supplier statements and track outstanding payments.

- Record and classify business expenses and non-customer Wise transactions.



3. Inventory & General Ledger Management

- Maintain accurate inventory records, including purchases, stock movements and stock balances.

- Reconcile inventory purchases against supplier invoices.

- Review the chart of accounts monthly and investigate unusual transactions or incorrect classifications.

- Prepare and post manual journal entries, including commission income, clearing accounts and accounting adjustments.

- Ensure transactions are correctly classified and supported by documentation.



4. Financial Reporting & Compliance

- Manage full sets of accounts and monthly closing.

- Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports.

- Monitor expenses, revenue, outstanding receivables and cash flow.

- Support Singapore GST reporting, year-end accounts and tax preparation.

- Maintain proper financial documentation and audit trails.



5. Process Improvement

- Develop and maintain clear accounting SOPs.

- Identify accounting errors, inefficiencies and opportunities for automation.

- Coordinate with operations and technical teams to improve accounting workflows and system integrations.



Requirements

Must-Have

- Minimum 5 years of accounting experience, including independently managing full sets of accounts.

- Strong hands-on proficiency in Xero.

- Experience with Stripe payment reconciliation, including fees, refunds and payouts.

- Strong knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, journal entries and general ledger reconciliation.

- Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify and resolve discrepancies independently.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Organised, reliable and able to meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Preferred

- Experience handling accounting for Singapore companies.

- Familiarity with Singapore GST and accounting standards.

- Experience with Wise, Zoho CRM and inventory accounting.

- Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces or service-based businesses.

- CPA, ACCA or equivalent accounting qualification.



What We're Looking For



> We need someone who can take full ownership of our accounting operations, not just perform data entry.

> You should be proactive in identifying errors, following up on discrepancies, keeping accounts accurate and ensuring financial reports are completed on time.



How to Apply

Please submit your CV and answer the following:

1. How many years of accounting experience do you have?

2. Have you independently managed full sets of accounts?

3. Describe your experience with Xero and Stripe.

4. Have you handled accounting for a Singapore company?

5. What is your last drawn salary and expected monthly salary?

6. What is your earliest available start date?



Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Google Business Profile Outbound Caller / Specialist
description:
We’re hiring an experienced Google Business Profile (GBP) Outbound Caller / Specialist to work directly with U.S.-based haulers and help move them through our Google Business Profile setup and verification process.



This is an urgent hire, and we are looking for someone who can start on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.



This is a calling-heavy role, so we are looking for someone who is confident speaking with people over the phone, following up consistently, overcoming hesitation, and getting people to complete their next step.



You will contact prospective and interested haulers, explain how the process works, collect the information we need, schedule verification calls or walkthroughs, and follow up until the profile is successfully created and verified.



You will also assist with Google Business Profile setup, optimization, verification issues, and ongoing profile management.



This is not a role for someone who only knows basic GBP optimization. We need someone who understands Google Business Profiles and is comfortable getting on the phone every day.



Key Responsibilities



- Outbound Calling & Hauler Follow-Up

- Make outbound calls to prospective and interested U.S.-based haulers.

- Explain our Google Business Profile setup and verification process clearly and confidently.

- Qualify haulers and determine whether their business/location meets GBP requirements.

- Collect required business information and supporting documentation.

- Schedule video verification sessions, walkthroughs, and follow-up calls.

- Guide haulers through what they need to prepare for verification.

- Follow up consistently with haulers who have not completed their next step.

- Handle common questions, concerns, and objections professionally.

- Keep conversations moving toward a clear next action.

- Maintain accurate notes after every call and interaction.



Google Business Profile Setup & Verification



- Create and configure Google Business Profiles.

- Work with both service-area businesses and location-based businesses.

- Set up categories, services, business hours, contact details, service areas, website links, and other profile information.

- Review locations and business information for GBP eligibility before proceeding.

- Guide haulers through Google verification requirements, including video verification when required.

- Troubleshoot failed or delayed verification attempts.



Suspensions & Reinstatements



- Identify possible causes of profile suspensions or restrictions.

- Correct underlying profile issues before submitting appeals.

- Gather legitimate supporting documentation.

- Submit reinstatement or appeal requests when required.

- Track cases and follow up with Google until resolved.



Profile Management & Optimization



- Monitor profiles for verification issues, unexpected edits, duplicates, inaccurate information, or suspensions.

- Keep listings complete and accurate.

- Optimize relevant categories, services, descriptions, photos, and other profile elements.

- Assist with review monitoring and responses.



Identify opportunities to improve local visibility and customer conversion.



Tracking & Follow-Up



Maintain an organized tracker showing:



- Hauler/business name

- Contact information

- Current GBP status

- Last contact

- Call outcome

- Verification status

- Open issues

- Next action

- Follow-up date



You are expected to take ownership of your pipeline and follow up without needing repeated reminders.



Requirements



To be considered, you must have:



- Strong outbound calling experience, preferably speaking with U.S.-based customers, contractors, business owners, or leads.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking on the phone and guiding people through a process.

- Experience following up with leads until an action is completed.

- Hands-on experience with Google Business Profiles.

- Experience creating and verifying Google Business Profiles.

- Understanding of service-area businesses and location-based businesses.

- Familiarity with Google Business Profile verification requirements.

- Ability to troubleshoot GBP problems independently.

- Strong organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple haulers/profiles simultaneously.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional environment for making calls.

- Availability for 40 hours per week, including scheduled calls during U.S. business hours.



Must be available to start Wednesday, October 28, 2026.



Strong Plus



- Experience handling GBP suspensions and reinstatement appeals.

- Experience with U.S. home-service businesses.

- Local SEO experience.

- Citation management or citation audit experience.

- Previous experience working with contractors, junk removal companies, haulers, movers, landscapers, or other local service businesses.

- Experience working with CRM or lead-management systems.



Success in This Role Means



You are successful when:



Calls are consistently completed and properly documented.

Haulers understand exactly what they need to do next.

Follow-ups happen without management having to remind you.

Interested haulers continue moving through the process instead of getting stuck.

Verification appointments are scheduled and completed.

Profiles are created accurately and successfully verified.

GBP issues are identified and addressed quickly.

Your pipeline and tracker are always current and organized.



How to Apply



We are reviewing applications immediately and plan to hire someone who can start on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. Please only apply if you are available to start on that date.



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short summary of your outbound calling experience, including the types of customers or leads you have called.

2. A short summary of your Google Business Profile experience, including approximately how many profiles you have personally created, verified, or managed.

3. Describe your experience with GBP video verification, suspensions, or reinstatement appeals, if applicable.

4. Tell us how you normally handle a prospect who is interested but keeps delaying the next step.

5. Submit a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your relevant experience. Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.

title: signage / wrap designer
description:
# Job Title: Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer



**Department:** Creative & Production



**Reports To:** Production Manager / Creative Director



**Job Type:** Full-Time



---



## Role Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical **Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer** to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Design & Concept Creation



* Design custom, high-resolution graphics for partial and full vehicle wraps, fleet vehicles, window vinyl, wall murals, dimensional signage, and banners.

* Utilize specialized vehicle templates (e.g., Pro Vehicle Outlines, Badie) to precisely position graphics across complex 3D vehicle body contours, body seams, door handles, and windows.

* Build realistic 2D and 3D photo mockups for client approvals to accurately represent the final installed product.

* Interpret client branding guidelines, logos, and briefs to create eye-catching visual concepts that align with the client’s marketing goals.



### Prepress & Production File Preparation



* Convert approved concepts into precision, print-ready vector/raster files scaled at full size (1:1) or accurate architectural scale (e.g., 1:10).

* Set up print files with appropriate bleeds, overlapping panels, tiling, overlap seam allowances, and vector contour cut lines (CutContour).

* Ensure correct color profiling (CMYK, Pantone/PMS matching) and image resolution settings to prevent pixelation on large-format outputs.

* Nest cut graphics and print files efficiently to minimize material waste during printing and cutting.





Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Qualifications & Skills



### Required



* **Experience:** 2–5+ years of proven graphic design experience specifically in the sign, large-format print, or vehicle wrap industry.

* **Software Proficiency:** Advanced mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (specifically **Adobe Illustrator** and **Adobe Photoshop**).

* **Technical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of vector graphics, raster resolution requirements (DPI vs. dimensions), scale calculations, and color theory (CMYK vs. RGB vs. Spot Colors).

* **Spatial Awareness:** Demonstrated ability to visualize flat 2D designs applied to complex 3D surfaces (curves, rivets, recessed panels).

* **Attention to Detail:** Meticulous approach to measurements, spell-checking, bleed allowances, and file organization.

* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills for presenting concepts to clients and technical handoffs to installers.

title: Creative Strategist - DTC and Meta Paid Social
description:
About the Role

This is a strategy-first role. You will own the creative thinking for two to three DTC accounts — the desires we go after, the avatars we speak to, the angles we test, the concepts that carry them, and the briefs that get them made.

You do not edit video, design statics, or buy media. You will occasionally build reference frames so an editor can see what you mean, but execution is not your job. D
 what gets made, and why, is.

Most of the work sits in health, wellness, and supplements, with room to expand into other e-commerce categories. It is a crowded, compliance-tight space where the gap between a winning ad and a dead one is almost always the angle, not the production quality.



Work Structure & Requirements

Schedule: Central European Time

Compensation: 8 USD per hour **negotiable



Key Responsibilities

1. Creative Strategy

Start from the desire the product actually serves, not the feature list

Identify the core avatar and sub-avatars underneath it, defined by what they have already tried and why it failed them

Turn those into testable angles, then into concepts, then into briefs — three different things, and you brief all three

Maintain a pipeline across angles, formats, hooks, and offers, with a stated reason for every test

Balance net-new concepts against iterations of proven winners

2. Brief Writing

Produce 5–15 briefs per client per week depending on scope, across short-form video, UGC, statics, and native-style formats

Every brief ships ready to execute: hook and opening concept, core message, script or talking points, visual direction, CTA, required assets, and editing notes

Write scripts yourself — an editor should never have to come back and ask what you meant

3. Research

Mine Amazon reviews (positive and negative) for the words customers actually use

Use Google searches to find what the market is confused about

Analyze Meta Ad Library and other ad libraries — what competitors are running, how long it has been live, and the technique underneath it rather than the line itself

Review competitor sites, offers, pricing, and landing pages

Pull voice of customer from Reddit, YouTube comments, ad comments, support tickets, and forums — their own sentence reads as recognition; a paraphrased problem reads as marketing

Identify what the market has already been told and already tried, so you stop repeating a claim it stopped believing

4. Performance Review & Recommendations

Come to performance reviews having already asked for the data you need — chasing the right numbers is part of the role

Diagnose why something won or lost specifically: was it the angle or the execution?

Recommend what to kill, what to iterate, and what to leave running — with the reasoning behind each call

Feed learnings directly into the next round of briefs

5. AI Integration

Use AI as part of your workflow for research, synthesis, ideation support, reference frames, and speeding up mechanical parts of the job

Hooks, angles, and scripts come from you — not AI



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years personally owning creative strategy for DTC paid social — in-house or agency; owning it, not contributing to it

Performance Mindset: You judge creative on hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA/ROAS against a target — not on whether it looks good

Conceptual Clarity: You can explain the difference between a desire, an avatar, an angle, a concept, and a hook without hedging

Copywriting: Excellent written English and real copywriting ability — the hook is the job; you write UGC scripts yourself and brief editors and creators directly

Awareness Levels: You write for different levels of awareness and know why a hook that lands on someone already shopping falls flat on someone who hasn't named the problem yet

Iteration: You iterate deliberately — you know what to change in a winner and what to leave alone

Compliance: Comfortable inside a compliance-tight category; health and supplement claims live within real limits and you write inside them by instinct

Organization: Organized enough to carry two to three brands at once without dropping a deadline

Bonus: Agency experience, worked directly alongside Meta media buyers, experience with advertorials, VSLs, and long-form direct response



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, introduction video and portfolio

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — Storage Unit / Reselling Content (POV Vlog Style)
description:
Type: Part-time to full-time, long-term (remote, Philippines-based)

Pay: $400–$600/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise

Start: Paid test edit ($10–$20) before any commitment



About the content

I buy storage units at auction and film the entire process. Each finished video is 15–20+ minutes and follows this format:

1. Intro to camera — "I just bought this unit for $X, let's see what I found."

2. POV searching footage — the bulk of the video is shot on Meta smart glasses and a body cam while I dig through the unit, narrating what I'm finding in real time.

3. Value reveals — as items are found, big on-screen text pop-ups show what they're worth ("$87!"), sold eBay comp screenshots appear on screen, and money sound effects (ka-ching) play.

Think treasure-hunt / unboxing vlog pacing: the hook is the discovery, the payoff is the value reveal.

Style reference

Harrison Nevel on YouTube — same genre (buying storage units at auction, going through them on camera). His videos are very polished, pro-level work with a cameraman; I don't expect that level, but he's the right reference for the format: intro hook, searching footage, and value reveals. Example: "I Risked $1020 On An Abandoned Storage Unit..." — 

Aim for a solid, watchable version of that energy: clean cuts, clear value pop-ups, and pacing that keeps people watching.

What you'll do

• Cut 1–3 hours of raw multi-camera footage down to a tight 15–20 minute video

• Aggressively cut dead air and boring searching — keep the pacing snappy

• Add animated value pop-ups, sold eBay comp screenshots (I provide the comps and values, you place and style them), and money sound effects

• Background music that fits the energy without overpowering narration

• Light color/exposure matching between camera sources (Meta glasses, body cam, intro camera)

• Strong hooks — the first 30 seconds need to sell the video

• Export in 1080p (YouTube-ready), organized project files

Requirements

• 2+ years editing YouTube content (vlog, unboxing, POV, or creator-style — not corporate)

• Expert in Premiere Pro (After Effects or CapCut Pro a plus)

• Strong sense of pacing: you know when to cut, when to linger on a find, when to drop a sound effect

• Good written English for on-screen text

• Portfolio with at least 2–3 examples of creator-style or vlog editing

• Reliable internet and your own editing setup

How to apply

1. Send a link to your portfolio (YouTube links preferred)

2. Tell me your editing software and how many years you've been editing creator content

3. Answer: what's your process for keeping a 15-minute vlog video engaging from start to finish?

Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid test edit ($10–$20): a short segment of real footage to edit in the style described above. This is the main thing I hire on — show me the pacing, the pop-ups, and the sound design.

Alpha Technical Training is seeking a proactive, commercially minded Student Accounts & Collections Officer to manage outstanding student payments and maximise cash collection.



This is not a traditional payment reminder or administrative follow-up role.



We are looking for someone who knows how to have difficult financial conversations, negotiate payment arrangements, overcome objections and turn outstanding balances into successful collections.



Many of our students are working professionals completing trade qualifications. They may experience financial difficulties, competing priorities or delays in completing their payments.



Your responsibility is to understand their circumstances, identify practical solutions and negotiate mutually acceptable payment arrangements while maintaining positive student relationships.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Payment Recovery & Negotiation

- Proactively contact students with outstanding course fees.

- Understand the actual reasons behind delayed payments.

- Negotiate realistic payment arrangements within company-approved guidelines.

- Offer structured instalment plans where appropriate.

- Secure specific payment commitments, including amounts and dates.

- Follow through on commitments until payments are received.

- Identify opportunities to recover overdue balances earlier without placing unreasonable pressure on students.



2. Objection Handling & Problem Solving

- Confidently handle objections such as:

“I can’t afford to pay right now.”

“I’ll pay next month.”

“I’m waiting for my salary.”

“I’m too busy.”

“I’ll get back to you.”

- Ask effective questions to understand the student’s financial circumstances.

- Explore alternative arrangements rather than accepting the first objection.

- Identify genuine financial hardship and escalate cases requiring special consideration.

- Know when to negotiate, when to follow up and when to escalate.



3. Student Relationship Management

- Build trust and maintain professional relationships with students.

- Explain outstanding balances, payment deadlines and agreed arrangements clearly.

- Help students understand the administrative and contractual implications of outstanding payments without making misleading statements or threats.

- Maintain a supportive but commercially focused communication style.

- Resolve payment-related concerns and disputes professionally.



4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate payment notes and follow-up records in 
.

- Record objections, payment commitments, agreed instalments and next actions.

- Monitor overdue balances and broken payment arrangements.

- Provide daily collection reports and weekly cashflow forecasts.

- Identify students with high recovery potential and prioritise accordingly.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:



- Success in this role will be measured by:

- Total outstanding cash successfully collected.

- Percentage of overdue balances recovered.

- Payment commitments successfully converted into receipts.

- Number and value of realistic payment arrangements negotiated.

- Reduction in overdue account balances.

- Quality of student communication and compliance with collection procedures.

- We value actual collections and sustainable payment arrangements, not simply the number of calls made.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



- Minimum 2 years’ experience in credit collection, accounts receivable, debt recovery or payment negotiation.

- Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

- Confident conducting payment discussions over the phone.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
EDUSFERE

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

K–12 Independent Schools  |  Work From Home (Philippines-Based)  |  Full-Time Hours | US School Hours



About the Role



Edusfere is a B2B SaaS edtech company that offers cutting-edge curriculum mapping software for K–12 schools. We are looking for a driven and articulate Sales Development Representative to work with our team as an independent contractor, engaged directly by Edusfere (no agency). In this role, you will be the first point of contact for independent K–12 schools primarily in the United States, plus selected international markets, generating qualified pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting and inbound lead management.



The ideal candidate brings B2B sales experience in SaaS or edtech, and direct experience in education, either as a former teacher, school administrator, or someone who has sold products and services into K–12 schools. You understand the language of educators, the rhythms of the school year, and how purchase decisions are made at independent schools. This domain expertise, paired with strong sales acumen and clear, confident English, will set you apart.



Key Responsibilities



* Outbound prospecting: Research target schools and contact school leaders (Heads of School, Principals, Directors of Learning) by phone,
, and LinkedIn, using lead lists and outreach campaigns we provide, to generate qualified demos.

Inbound lead management: Respond to and qualify inbound leads in a timely manner; assess fit, educate prospects on Edusfere’s value proposition, and book qualified demos with our sales lead.

* Book demos: Qualify interest and book qualified demos with our sales lead. After approval, run demos and sales conversations through to signed contracts.

* Callbacks and inquiries: Respond promptly to schools that call back or reply.

* CRM: Log every call, note, and outcome in HubSpot the same day.

* Feedback: Share what you hear from schools each week so we can improve our pitch and targeting.

* Market intelligence: Stay current on trends in independent school education, edtech adoption, and competitive landscape to refine messaging and targeting.



Required Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience in a sales, business development, or SDR role with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota.

* Native or near-native English proficiency with excellent written and verbal communication skills—you must be able to hold natural, confident conversations with US-based school leaders.

* Proficiency with CRM tools (HubSpot or similar).

* Available about 8 hours a day, Monday–Friday, on a schedule you set within US school hours (8:00 AM Eastern to 5:00 PM Pacific, roughly 9:00 PM–9:00 AM PHT).

* Work-from-home setup: reliable internet of at least 25 Mbps, backup internet (e.g. mobile data or pocket Wi-Fi) and backup power, a noise-cancelling headset, a webcam, a mobile phone, a quiet workspace, and a laptop or desktop in good working condition with a secure operating system and antivirus.

* Registered, or willing to register, with the BIR as self-employed.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience in the K–12 education sector: prior work as a classroom teacher, school administrator, admissions officer, or in an education-focused sales role.

* Experience selling into schools, school districts, or education institutions (independent, private, or international schools preferred).

* Familiarity with international school markets (Asia, Middle East, Latin America, Europe).

* Background in edtech, SaaS, or education services sales.

* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Communications, or a related field.



What Success Looks Like



* After ramp-up, consistently booking 15–20+ qualified demos per month with school decision-makers (Heads of School, Directors of Learning, Directors of Curriculum, or similar titles).

* Building a healthy pipeline of opportunities across US independent schools, plus selected international markets.

* Becoming a trusted first impression of Edusfere—school leaders feel they are speaking with someone who genuinely understands their world.

* Contributing insights from the front lines that improve Edusfere’s messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy.



Fees & Incentives



* Monthly fee: ₱45,000–65,000, depending on experience.

* Uncapped incentive pay: Under our current Sales Incentive Plan, a bonus for every qualified demo held, plus commission on deals that close.

* Training: Paid onboarding on our product, the US school market, and our sales process.

* Growth: A path to closing deals yourself at a higher commission rate, and into a senior sales role as Edusfere scales.

* Work from home: Fully remote; no commute.

* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture focused on transforming K–12 education.



How to Apply



If you are passionate about education and thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit:

* Your resume.

* A brief cover note explaining your B2B sales experience, any connection to education, and why this role interests you.

* A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself in English.

* A screenshot of a recent internet speed test.



Engagement type: This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The selected candidate will provide services under an Independent Contractor Agreement with Edusfere, LLC, a US company, and will not be an employee of Edusfere or of any Philippine entity. You will set your own schedule within US school hours and decide how and where you perform the work. As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for your own taxes and BIR registration, government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), equipment, internet, and workspace. You will not be entitled to employee benefits such as leave, 13th-month pay, overtime, holiday pay, or night-shift differential. Fees are paid monthly in Philippine pesos against your invoice. You may provide services to other clients, provided there is no conflict of interest.



Edusfere welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and is committed to equal opportunity.

title: Freelance Talent Coordinator & Brand Outreach Specialist
description:
Freelance Talent Coordinator & Brand Outreach Specialist



Company: Lucious Talent

Employment Type: Part-Time, Freelance / Independent Contractor

Hours: 25 hours per week (approximately 5 hours per day, Monday–Friday)

Monthly Compensation: $350 USD + Performance-Based Bonuses

Platform: Upwork



About Lucious Talent



Lucious Talent is a growing talent management agency specializing in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, and digital creators. We represent emerging and established social media personalities, helping them secure brand partnerships, negotiate opportunities, and develop long-term relationships with brands.



We’re expanding our roster and looking for a motivated, organized, and results-driven Talent Coordinator & Brand Outreach Specialist to join our growing team.



This position is ideal for someone who understands influencer marketing, enjoys brand relationship building, and can consistently identify and pursue partnership opportunities.



Position Overview



The selected candidate will primarily oversee brand research, outbound pitching, partnership prospecting, and administrative coordination.



You will work directly with the agency’s founder and talent manager to identify relevant brands, develop outreach opportunities, maintain organized pitching records, and support the agency’s growing creator roster.



We’re looking for someone who can dedicate approximately five hours per weekday and take ownership of their assigned responsibilities.



Key Responsibilities



1. Brand Outreach & Partnership Development



* Research and identify brands that align with our creators’ niches, audiences, and content.

* Conduct outbound
 outreach to brands, PR agencies, and influencer marketing representatives.

* Pitch creators for paid collaborations, sponsored campaigns, gifting opportunities, and long-term partnerships.

* Maintain consistent follow-ups with brands that have not responded.

* Build and maintain relationships with brand representatives and marketing teams.

* Prioritize paid collaborations and commercially valuable opportunities.



2. Creator & Brand Research



* Identify potential brand partnerships for each creator.

* Research brand campaign history, marketing contacts, and partnership opportunities.

* Maintain an organized database of potential brand contacts.

* Identify relevant PR opportunities and creator casting opportunities.



3. Administrative & Talent Coordination



* Maintain pitching spreadsheets and outreach records.

* Organize brand communication and categorize outreach by creator and month.

* Track sent pitches, responses, follow-ups, and potential opportunities.

* Assist with scheduling, campaign calendars, and internal coordination.

* Review incoming brand agreements and flag clauses or concerns for the founder’s review.



4. Reporting & Performance Tracking



* Provide consistent updates on outreach activity.

* Maintain accurate records of all pitching activity.

* Monitor response rates and identify opportunities to improve outreach strategies.

* Meet monthly pitching targets and maintain professional communication standards.



Monthly Performance Expectations



We are looking for someone who can consistently produce results rather than simply complete administrative tasks.



All monthly pitching targets are calculated per creator, not collectively across the agency’s roster.



Expected monthly output per creator:



* 100 pitches: Minimum monthly outreach requirement.

* 150 pitches: Preferred performance target.

* 200 pitches: Upper monthly target.



These targets apply individually to every creator assigned to the coordinator. For example, if you are assigned three creators, the minimum monthly requirement would be 300 pitches across those three creators.



All outreach must be personalized, relevant, and directed toward brands that genuinely align with our creators.



Quality matters just as much as quantity. Mass-produced, irrelevant, or repetitive pitches will not count toward performance expectations.



Compensation & Bonuses



Base Compensation: $350 USD per month.



This is a part-time freelance position with an expected commitment of approximately 25 hours per week.



Additional Performance Compensation



* 5% commission bonus: Earn 5% of the agency commission actually received from qualifying brand partnerships directly generated through your outreach efforts.

* Trial Month Performance Bonus: An additional $100 USD may be awarded at the end of the initial 30-day trial period based on overall performance, consistency, communication, organization, and achievement of assigned targets.



The commission bonus is calculated from the agency’s commission, not the creator’s gross campaign payment.



All compensation and bonuses will be processed through Upwork in accordance with its payment policies and the agreed contract terms.



Initial 30-Day Trial Period



The first 30 days will serve as an introductory evaluation period.



During this period, we will assess:



* Quality and consistency of brand outreach.

* Ability to meet pitching targets.

* Written English proficiency and professional communication.

* Organization and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Understanding of influencer marketing and brand partnerships.



Successful completion of the trial period may lead to continued engagement and additional responsibilities as the agency grows.



Qualifications & Requirements



* Previous experience in influencer marketing, talent management, PR, brand outreach, or business development is preferred.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong professional
 communication skills.

* Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, influencer campaigns, and social media marketing.

* Experience with Google Workspace, Google Sheets, and
 management.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Reliable internet connection and consistent availability.

* Ability to dedicate approximately five hours per weekday.



Important: We require original, personalized outreach. AI-generated brand pitches or automated mass
 submissions are not permitted. Candidates must be comfortable researching brands and writing professional outreach independently.



Important Role Boundaries



This position focuses on brand outreach and internal talent coordination.



The selected candidate will not independently:



* Negotiate final campaign rates or contractual terms.

* Accept or decline brand partnership offers on behalf of the agency.

* Sign agreements or make binding commitments.

* Independently manage creator relationships or communicate management decisions to represented talent.



All final partnership negotiations, deal approvals, and creator management decisions remain with the agency’s founder and talent manager.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your professional experience.

2. Previous experience with influencer marketing, brand outreach, or talent coordination.

3. Examples of brand pitches or professional outreach
s you have personally written (with confidential information removed).

4. Any relevant experience working with talent agencies, PR firms, or marketing agencies.

5. Your availability and confirmation that you can dedicate approximately five hours per weekday.

6. Your familiarity with Google Workspace and influencer marketing platforms.



We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, detail-oriented, and interested in growing alongside a developing talent management agency.



Lucious Talent is looking for a long-term professional working relationship with the right candidate.

title: Part-Time Xero Bookkeeper (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Weekly — one fixed day each week

● Reconcile the bank and credit card accounts in Xero, leaving nothing unreconciled

● Code every transaction to the correct account, the correct property (via tracking categories) and critically the correct VAT rate

● Reconcile booking platform payouts (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, direct/Stripe), recording gross booking income, platform commission and cleaning fees separately rather than posting only the net amount that lands in the bank

● Process supplier bills and receipts from our outsourced providers — cleaning, laundry, maintenance, management and software subscriptions

● Raise and send sales invoices for direct bookings, corporate or extended stays, and any re-charges

● Chase overdue invoices politely and keep the aged debtors list short

● Send a brief weekly update: what was done, what is outstanding, and any queries for us

Monthly

● Close the month by the [7th] working day

● Deliver the management pack: Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Aged Debtors, Aged Creditors and a simple cash summary

● Present the P&L per property as well as consolidated, so we can see which unit is performing

● Include a short written commentary — what moved, what looks unusual, what needs a decision from us. This matters to us as much as the numbers do.

● Reconcile control accounts: VAT, director’s loan, supplier balances and platform clearing accounts

● Confirm all recurring costs have landed — rent, business rates, energy, broadband, insurance and subscriptions

VAT and Making Tax Digital

This is a core part of the role, not an add-on.

● Prepare the quarterly VAT return for our review and submit it through Xero under MTD, comfortably ahead of the deadline (one calendar month and seven days after the quarter end)

● Apply the correct VAT treatment to income short-term holiday and serviced accommodation is standard-rated, unlike long-term residential letting

● Handle reverse charge VAT on commission and services invoiced from overseas platforms (for example Airbnb and Booking.com) correctly on the return

● Apply the correct input VAT rate to each cost — for example, business rates carry no VAT, domestic-rate energy may be reduced-rated, broadband and most services are standard-rated, and rent may be exempt unless the landlord has opted to tax

● Reconcile the VAT control account every month rather than only at quarter end, so surprises are caught early

● Maintain MTD-compliant digital records and digital links — no manual re-keying between systems

● Keep VAT evidence complete: a valid VAT invoice on file for every input VAT claim, chased from suppliers where missing

● Flag anything with an uncertain VAT treatment to us and our accountant rather than making an assumption

● Review, when asked, whether an alternative scheme ([standard / cash accounting / flat rate]) would suit the business better

Annual

● Prepare the year-end file and deal directly with our UK accountant’s queries

● Keep the chart of accounts, VAT rates and tracking categories tidy and consistent

Short-term rental specifics

● Reconcile each platform’s payout report to the bank — payouts arrive net of commission and often cover several bookings across a date split

● Keep the three properties cleanly separated so per-property profitability is always visible

● Split repairs and maintenance from capital improvements and furnishing costs correctly

● Track refundable damage deposits, guest refunds and chargebacks properly, including their VAT treatment

● Account for rent and other fixed property costs against the correct property and the correct period

Requirements

Essential

● Minimum 2–3 years’ hands-on bookkeeping in Xero — running the books day to day, not simply "familiar with" the software

● Demonstrable experience of bank reconciliation, raising and sending invoices, and producing monthly Profit & Loss statements

● Practical experience preparing and filing UK VAT returns under Making Tax Digital for a VAT-registered business

● Confident applying different VAT rates and knowing when VAT is not recoverable

● Experience working with UK-based clients and UK bookkeeping conventions

● Accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent practical experience

● Strong written and spoken English — you will
 suppliers and our accountant directly

● Confident in Excel or Google Sheets

● Reliable internet with a backup connection

● Genuine attention to detail — you notice when a figure looks wrong

Desirable

● Xero Advisor certification

● Experience with short-term rentals, serviced accommodation, Airbnb or hospitality clients

● Experience reconciling payment platform payouts (Airbnb, Booking.com, Stripe, PayPal)

● Familiarity with reverse charge VAT and cross-border service invoices

● Multi-property or multi-entity bookkeeping

Our work spans practical sales and marketing automation through to AI ecosystems for enterprise-sized businesses, including work in health clinics, childcare, real estate and logistics.



Our ambition goes beyond individual AI tools. We’re developing connected systems that bring together business knowledge, workflows and AI agents—a practical business “second brain” that helps teams achieve more.



We have customers to serve and products to develop across Australia, New Zealand and soon USA. Now we need a commercially capable person to help turn that foundation into repeatable growth.

You will:



- **Shape our offers:** understand customer problems and turn our capabilities into clear positioning, packages, demonstrations and proposals.

- **Take products to market:** help select promising customer segments, launch campaigns and test what generates demand.

- **Drive marketing:** create or coordinate social content, video and campaigns using AI tools and sound commercial judgement.

- **Build and manage sales:** prospect, qualify enquiries, run conversations, maintain the pipeline, follow up proposals and close business within agreed authority.

- **Support early customers:** coordinate onboarding, communicate clearly, follow through on commitments and identify opportunities to improve retention and expand accounts.

- **Inform product development:** bring customer evidence to the founder and technical team so we build what people need and will pay for.

- **Build repeatable processes:** establish practical routines in GoHighLevel and document what works as the team grows.



You will work alongside our founder and technical lead. You are not expected to be the sole engineer, designer and salesperson—but you must be willing to execute across the commercial work while we are small.



## What you must bring



- Evidence that you have helped launch, sell or grow a product or service—not simply held a relevant title.

- Experience working with Australian businesses or serving Australian customers, with an understanding of their communication and commercial expectations.

- Excellent spoken and written English, including confidence on customer calls and video meetings.

- The ability to turn an unclear opportunity into a practical plan and follow it through.

How to apply

What you personally owned and what results you achieved.



Why you believe you should be shortlisted.

The product, industry and market.



The starting situation and your responsibilities.



What you did, over what period, and the measurable result.



What a former manager or client could verify.

title: Outbound Sales Closer (Recovery Sales / Post-Purchase Upsell)
description:
About us



We are a fast-growing DTC kitchen brand building a premium portfolio of cookware and food storage products for customers across the US.



We're a 60+ person team continuing to scale quickly, with a strong focus on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences. As we grow, our Sales Team plays a key role in helping customers make the right decisions, recover missed opportunities, and maximize the value of every customer interaction.



We're looking for driven sales professionals who want to be part of a growing team, take ownership of their results, and play a direct role in Plateful's continued growth.



The Opportunity



We're looking for driven, persistent, and consultative Outbound Sales Reps who can turn warm customer interactions into revenue and maximize every sales opportunity. You'll connect with customers at different stages of their buying journey, from those who showed strong intent but didn't complete their purchase, to existing customers who have just placed an order. Your role is to reconnect, understand their needs, overcome objections or payment concerns, and confidently guide them toward the right solution.



This includes recovering abandoned carts and declined transactions, as well as identifying post-purchase upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Every customer you speak with has already interacted with our brand, visited our store, attempted to purchase, or recently completed an order.

This is not cold calling. You'll be working with warm leads and existing customers, making every conversation an opportunity to recover a sale, increase order value, and create a better customer experience.



We're looking for people who build trust quickly, communicate confidently, and genuinely enjoy the challenge of turning customer conversations into successful outcomes.



Requirements

Read these carefully before applying:



* Strong upsell and cross-sell skills are non-negotiable. Recovering the sale is the baseline. The ability to grow order value and maximize every customer opportunity is where you win. 

* Proven experience in sales recovery, win-back, retention, upselling, or cross-selling, ideally in a consultative or high-ticket sales environment. $1K+ AOV experience is preferred. 

* Shopify and CRM experience is a must. You should be comfortable navigating orders, carts, and customer records without hand-holding. 

* Must be comfortable working EST hours, including night shifts and rotating weekday schedules. Shift start times may vary. 

* Excellent objection handling and closing skills. You should be comfortable handling price concerns, payment issues, hesitation, and other barriers to purchase. 

* Clear, confident, and persuasive communicator who can build trust quickly and guide customers toward a purchase decision. 

* KPI- and performance-driven with a strong ownership mindset. You track your numbers, understand your targets, and take responsibility for your results. 

* Fast learner, coachable, and execution-focused. You take feedback well and can quickly apply it to improve your performance.



Compensation & Benefits



* Fully Remote Position 

* Competitive Base Salary 

* Uncapped 5% Commission During Your First Month 

* Tiered Commission Structure From Month 2 Onwards 

* Daily Spiffs & Performance Incentives

Paid Leave Benefits

title: Engineering Team Coordinator (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering team coordinator who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

title: Product Manager (Technical) / Software Architect
description:
We are seeking a Technical Product Manager / Architect who bridges product design and engineering execution. This role combines system-level thinking, architectural oversight, and clear, actionable documentation—producing deliverables engineers can build from directly. The ideal candidate can translate business needs into architecture diagrams, wireframes, and well-scoped tickets with code-level precision, ensuring efficient handoff and reduced rework.



Requirements & Documentation

• Author architecture-aware product specifications including system diagrams, logic flows, and key technical dependencies.

• Prepare engineer-ready tickets, including pseudocode, scaffolding, or sample API structures.

• Conduct architecture and code reviews, identifying potential design or implementation issues early.

• Build wireframes, mockups, and interaction flows using Figma or equivalent tools to align engineering and UX/UI early in the cycle.

• Collaborate with engineering to ensure technical feasibility and architectural scalability before feature commitment.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Work closely with engineering leads to break down architecture into structured deliverables and sprint-ready tasks.

• Lead technical review sessions to validate assumptions and architecture decisions before coding begins.



Qualifications

• Strong understanding of software architecture principles, REST APIs, and modular system design.

• Hands-on experience writing or reviewing code in PHP, JavaScript, and SQL preferred.

• Proficiency in creating wireframes, prototypes, and UI flows that accurately reflect data and system constraints.

• Ability to evaluate trade-offs between architectural purity, delivery speed, and scalability.

• Prior experience functioning as a bridge between engineering and design, ensuring clarity and readiness for execution.

title: Air-BnB Rental Sourcing Virtual Assistant
description:
Role Overview

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, reliable Virtual Assistant to source short-term rental apartments for our clients using Booking.com, Airbnb, Vrbo and Agoda.



When an enquiry comes in, you’ll search the platforms against the client’s requirements (location, dates, budget, number of guests, amenities, etc.), shortlist the best-matching properties and send back your results within 24 hours.



This is a remote, flexible role. You choose your own working hours. What matters is that every enquiry is turned around on time and to a high standard.



Key Responsibilities



Receive client enquiries and review the requirements carefully

Search Booking.com, Airbnb, Vrbo and Agoda for suitable short-term rental apartments

Use platform filters effectively (price range, dates, guests, bedrooms, property type, amenities, map/location, guest rating, cancellation policy, etc.)

Shortlist the strongest options and send them in the format provided (listing link, price, key details, notes)

Check listings for red flags (few or poor reviews, unclear photos, hidden fees, strict cancellation terms)

Return completed results within 24 hours of receiving each enquiry

Communicate promptly and flag any issues early



Workload



Approximately 10 enquiries per week

Work is on demand: enquiries can arrive at any time, Monday to Saturday



Schedule & Availability



Available Monday to Saturday

Flexible hours: work at the times that suit you

Must respond to enquiries on demand and deliver results within 24 hours per enquiry



Pay & Commission



Base pay: £50 every 2 weeks (approx. ₱4,135 PHP)

Commission: £40 per successful enquiry (approx. ₱3,310 PHP each)

A successful enquiry is one where a property you sourced is booked by the client, most of our clients are already returning clients.

Paid every 2 weeks.



PHP amounts are approximate (about £1 = ₱82.7) and will vary with the exchange rate at the time of payment.



Requirements



Confident using Booking.com, Airbnb, Vrbo and Agoda, including browsing and search filters

Strong attention to detail and ability to follow a client brief precisely

Good written English

Reliable internet connection and a laptop/computer

Able to meet the 24-hour turnaround consistently

Organised, responsive and able to work independently



Nice to have: experience in travel, hospitality, property sourcing or research-based VA work.



Training

Full training will be provided over a period of 4 days via Zoom call with screenshare. It covers our search process, how to use each platform’s filters, what makes a good listing and how to present your results.



You will receive an upfront payment of $15 for the 4-day training period.

title: Funnel builder using Funnelish for dropshipping products
description:
We’re looking for a part-time Funnelish funnel builder to help us build funnels for our dropshipping brands.



Our team works mostly in the health and beauty space, and we launch new products regularly. Because of that, we’re looking for someone who can quickly put together clean, conversion-focused funnels using Funnelish.



This is a part-time position, ideal for someone who already has experience building funnels and wants consistent work on a flexible basis.



How the role works



You’ll be given:



• The product

• The funnel structure or template

• Copy and creative assets



Your job is to build the funnel in Funnelish, making sure everything looks good, works smoothly, and is mobile-friendly.



Sometimes you may build multiple funnels in a day, other times fewer. The workload can vary depending on product launches.



Payment



We pay per funnel completed, not hourly.

This works well for people who build funnels efficiently and prefer being paid based on output.



Requirements



• Experience using Funnelish

• Experience with dropshipping or DTC funnels

• Comfortable working with health and beauty products

• Able to build funnels quickly and reliably

• Good attention to detail



Markets



Our main market is The Netherlands, but we also work with funnels for:



• Germany

• Nordic countries

• Israel



You don’t need to speak these languages, but you should be comfortable working with localized funnels and international markets.



Communication



Our team communicates primarily through 
, so you should be comfortable using it for updates and coordination.

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.
